title: 12 jours, 4 manifs, 2 occup' (et plein de blocus)
content:
L'occupation de la Bourse du Travail


Le jeudi 5 novembre, après

la manif

, l'Assemblée Générale de Cultures en lutte 69 pond un communiqué pour annoncer l'occupation de la salle Albert Thomas de la Bourse du Travail.


Depuis ce jour, l'Assemblée Générale de Cultures en lutte 69 (mouvement des étudiant·es et travailleur·ses de la Culture de Lyon) occupe la salle Albert Thomas de la Bourse du Travail de Lyon pour donner écho aux revendications de notre secteur et à celles de toutes les personnes en lutte (lycéen·nes, étudiant·es, travailleur·ses et retraité·es).

 Les Bourses du Travail sont des lieux d'organisation des travailleur•ses arrachées aux municipalités par les ouvrier•es à la fin du 19

e

 siècle. En novembre 1966, il y a soixante ans, Louis Pradel, alors Maire de Lyon, a fait voter à son conseil municipal la transformation de la salle Albert Thomas en salle uniquement dédiée aux spectacles plutôt qu'en lieu d'organisation des luttes du monde du travail. Nous récupérons aujourd'hui le lieu qui nous est dû, pour lui redonner sa fonction première.


Pendant 9 jours, la Bourse est donc occupée et devient le cœur névralgique de la mobilisation : AGs à gogo (interfac, interpro, occupation, culture, autonome, travailleur·euses de l'hôtellerie-café-restauration...)

 

; after manif

 

; projections

 

; crêpes <3 ...


Après de sombres histoires de concert, de producteurs énervés, de négociation avec la Mairie, de tags, de toilettes et d'alarme incendie... la salle Albert Thomas finit par être expulsée sous menace policière le samedi 14 novembre matin.


Lycéen·nes et étdudiant·es en lutte


Toute la semaine dernière (9/11) et cette semaine (16/11), les lycéen·nes et étudiant·es ont continué à se mobiliser, même si les relais médiatiques se sont fait moins nombreux... à part quand il s'est agit de pleurer sur l'impact des blocus sur la santé mentale des jeunes.


Côté lycées, la lutte a continué sous diverses formes et confrontée à un véritable durcissement de la répression, tant policière et judiciaire, que disciplinaire à l'intérieur des établissements. —>

Lire le bilan publié sur Rebellyon

.


Côté facs, Lyon 2 a continué sur sa lancé, et inauguré les blocus festifs sur le campus Porte des Alpes : pochoirs, chamboule tout tête de fafs, conférences,

AG

, frites, musique... au rendez-vous. Le Campus de La Doua (Lyon 1) a été partiellement bloqué à plusieurs reprises également, mais aussi Centrale Lyon. Les beaux arts ont perpétué leur université populaire, et des

AG

 ont continué à se tenir dans les établissements (Lyon 2, Lyon 1,

IEP

,

ENS

, Centrale...).


Manif du mardi 10 novembre


À l'appel de l'intersyndicale de l'éducation, peu encline d'attendre le prochain gros appel de l'intersyndicale, une manif festive et joyeuse a eu lieu le mardi 10/11. Le parcours : Jean Macé - Guichard, la Préfecture ayant refusé l'accès à la Presqu'île et à Bellecour. Des jeunes motivés et deter, la police est restée à distance, et une mini sauvage en fin de manif pour finir en beauté, mais rapidement gazée et dispersée.


Soutien et antirep


Plusieurs rassemblements de soutien, aux camarades interpelés en manif, ou aux camarades lycéens sur les blocus, se sont tenus ces 12 derniers jours. Une formation antirep a été organisée par Extinction Rebellion, et une autre à l'Amicale du futur le samedi 14, avec une permanence juridique exceptionnelle et un atelier contestation d'amendes.


On peut également mentionner des distribuations alimentaires gratuites à Lyon 3.


Enfin, côté Place de Milan, des piquets ant-expulsion se sont tenus tous les jours, alors que le collectif solidarité entre femmes à la rue explique être menacé d'expulsion par la Métropole.


Acte V : manif du samedi 14 novembre

!).


Toujours privé de Bellecour par la Préfecture, le cortège a défilé entre la Manufacture et Jean Macé en passant par le cours Garibaldi. On retient : le concert de l'orchestre en Luth à la Manu, une manif rapide, des sit ins et danses tout le long du cortège, une barricade de enflammée photogénique sur Berthelot, les journalistes de

BFM

 chassés, et des œuvres de qualité.

title: Acá, en la montaña. (Información importante para transportistas y familias buscadoras)
content:
Acá, en la montaña. (Información importante para transportistas y familias buscadoras)

La luna cae como guadaña sobre el horizonte de occidente, segando sueños y pesadillas.

La montaña se va descobijando por un sol impertinente. Desperezándose está. En su avance, el día la va descubriendo: primero el extenso bies de la alargada y verde nagua. Luego la arbolada de las rodillas, la cintura de la bulla de pájaros y animales, los breves senos asomándose, tímidos, entre la neblina. Y, al fin, la cabellera que, en lo más alto, le peina un viento frío a esa hora de la ya no tan madrugada.

Una mujer ya de edad baja por un sendero. En una mano lleva un manojo de hierbas. En la otra una niña de pocos años y cuartas sobre el suelo.

“Esta planta alivia el cólico. La montaña, que es como mujeres que somos, nos da esta hierba como regalo para que podamos caminar y trabajar, y no estar todo el día botadas como costal de pergamino vacío, haraganeando con el dolor de pretexto. Ahorita no lo sabes todavía, pero vas a saber. De por sí lo vas a saber ya que críes más”.

“Y esto que te cuento, me lo contó mi abuela, y a mi abuela su abuela. Y así por muchos años, tantos que las matemáticas no alcanzan a contar. Porque nosotras pasamos, pero la tierra queda. Igual nosotras quedamos en ustedes, las hijas y las nietas. Por eso nos preocupa si comen, si enferman, si faltan. Por eso las buscamos, para enseñarles, orientarlas, decirles que tengan bueno su pie y bueno su paso”

“A las abuelas nos toca enseñar, es nuestro trabajo. Ustedes, las niñas, su trabajo es vivir”

La niña asiente y mira el paso. Sabe que la mano de su abuela no es para que no se pierda, sino para apoyarse en ella, bastón vivo para la anciana que camina lento.

La abuela cree que ayuda y protege a la niña. La niña cree que protege y ayuda a la abuela.

Abajo, al pie de la montaña, en la champa, la madre espera las hierbas que le aliviarán el cólico que le muerde las entrañas. Un olor a maíz cocido, tortilla recién hecha y leña palpitando, rodea la champa. El padre y el hijo mayor salieron más temprano, pozol en las morraletas, a la milpa.

Un bebé llora, porque sí, porque no encuentra todavía las palabras, por decir “aquí estoy”.

Porque el llanto, amigas y enemigas, es también una señal de vida.

En el cuartel insurgente siguen los trabajos para crear los regalos para las madres buscadoras. Como las muñecas van con retraso, el SubMoy ha ordenado que algunos varones dejen la carpintería y se pasen al bordado.

Pero antes, cuando sólo estaban como mujeres que somos, las compañeras insurgentas intercambian informaciones. Comentan el último baile en la comunidad de jóvenes en común. Murmuran y ríen mientras miran de reojo a los hombres que, en la carpintería hacen las casitas-cajitas que servirán para que las muñecas no se abollen en el largo camino a la capital del país.

“Ese compa”, dice una, “sabe de bailar de sonidero, que es una nueva música que inventaron los ciudadanos”. Sin dejar de bordar la blusa, completa: “Urr, ahí andaba de un lado a otro, hasta parece que va a volar que de una vez que no se puede creer. Y los critica a los otros que no saben bailar sin pareja. Que sea sueltos. Nada de que la manita y esas cosas. Y los otros lo critican a él porque dicen que baila sonidero porque no encuentra pareja”.

“¿Y cómo sabes?” “Por una información que me compartieron” Todas ríen cómplices. “Yo”, dice otra, “acaso sé bailar. Nunca me bailé en mi pueblo, no sé, como que no me llama la atención. Pero entonces dijo el SubMoy que vayan al baile. Y, ni modos, es orden que hay que bailar. Y ahí estamos con mi prima dando nomás patadas como yegua brava. Creo nadie se dio cuenta o creyeron que es un nuevo baile”. Siguen platicando sin dejar de bordar los regalos que recuerdo y memoria serán para las familias buscadoras. Sin varones cerca, son libres para hablar de cosas de “como mujeres que somos”.

Pero ahora que hay varones compartiendo el trabajo, todo cambió. Ahora hasta se peinan. Y están como muy serias, como que son muy bien portadas. Y las risas son suplidas por los rubores que se pierden tras el cubrebocas, “porque hay mucha influenza” dijo la insurgenta de sanidad. Se arreglan la blusa, se ponen el pantalón bien trincado, que de una vez no se puede creer. Y se ponen violáceas de pena, porque como son de piel oscura, cuando se sonrojan quedan moradas sus mejillas.

Mirando la torpeza de los varones, una insurgenta, hábil en crear colores y figuras, dice: “yo creo …

title: 21 Νοέμβρη: Παγκόσμια Ημέρα Δράσης ενάντια στον Πόλεμο, Σάββατο 21/11, στις 14.00, στα Προπύλαια, Αθήνα
content:
Κάλεσμα/Αφίσα από την

 ΟΚΔΕ

:


ΕΞΩ Η ΕΛΛΑΔΑ ΑΠΟ ΤΑ ΠΟΛΕΜΙΚΑ ΣΦΑΓΕΙΑ!


ΛΕΦΤΑ ΓΙΑ ΤΙΣ ΑΝΑΓΚΕΣ ΜΑΣ – ΟΧΙ ΓΙΑ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥΣ!


Η ανθρωπότητα βρίσκεται μπροστά σε μια επικίνδυνη κλιμάκωση των πολεμικών συγκρούσεων.

Από την Ουκρανία μέχρι τη Μέση Ανατολή, οι λαοί πληρώνουν με αίμα την κρίση και τους ανταγωνισμούς του παγκόσμιου καπιταλιστικού συστήματος. Οι ΗΠΑ, το ΝΑΤΟ και η ΕΕ, στην προσπάθειά τους να διατηρήσουν την κυριαρχία τους απέναντι στην Κίνα και τη Ρωσία, πολλαπλασιάζουν εξοπλισμούς, επεμβάσεις και απειλές.

 Η ΗΠΑ δεν μπορούν να αποδεχτούν την ήττα τους και γι’ αυτό συνεχίζουν να χτυπούν το Ιράν. Πίσω από τις υποσχέσεις για «ειρήνη» και «ασφάλεια» βρίσκονται τα συμφέροντα των πολυεθνικών, ο έλεγχος των αγορών, των ενεργειακών πόρων και των δρόμων μεταφοράς.

Ο κίνδυνος γενικευμένου πολέμου μεγαλώνει.

 Η κούρσα των εξοπλισμών δεν προστατεύει τους λαούς, προετοιμάζει νέες σφαγές και απειλεί να μετατρέψει περιοχές σε πεδία αντιπαράθεσης.


Παράλληλα, εδώ και τρία χρόνια ο παλαιστινιακός λαός αντιμετωπίζει τη βία, τον εκτοπισμό και την γενοκτονία από το κράτος του Ισραήλ, με τη στήριξη των δυτικών ιμπεριαλιστών.

 Η αλληλεγγύη στην Παλαιστίνη δεν είναι ζήτημα φιλανθρωπίας, αλλά κοινός αγώνας ενάντια στην καταπίεση και τον ιμπεριαλισμό. Απαιτούμε να σταματήσουν οι επιθέσεις και η κατοχή, να αναγνωριστεί το δικαίωμα του παλαιστινιακού λαού σε ανεξάρτητο κράτος και αυτοδιάθεση.


Η κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη μάς βυθίζει βαθύτερα σε αυτούς τους σχεδιασμούς.

 Παραχωρεί στρατιωτικές βάσεις και υποδομές, μετατρέπει τα λιμάνια της Αλεξανδρούπολης, του Πειραιά και της Ελευσίνας σε κρίκους της πολεμικής αλυσίδας και εμφανίζει την πλήρη πρόσδεση σε ΗΠΑ και ΝΑΤΟ ως «γεωπολιτική αναβάθμιση». Αγοράζει διαρκώς εξοπλισμούς ύψους πολλών δις ευρώ, με πρόσφατη την αγορά στρατιωτικού υλικού ύψους 4 δισ. από τις ΗΠΑ και συμφωνία-μαμούθ 3 δισ. με το Ισραήλ για την κατασκευή της λεγόμενης «Ασπίδας του Αχιλλέα». Μετατρέπουν εργαζόμενους και νεολαία σε όμηρους επικίνδυνων ανταγωνισμών. Δε θα γίνουμε κρέας για τα κανόνια τους! Να κλείσουν οι στρατιωτικές βάσεις, να σταματήσει η αγορά οποιουδήποτε στρατιωτικού υλικού και να μην αξιοποιείται κανένα λιμάνι για επιθετικές επιχειρήσεις. Να σταματήσουμε τους επικίνδυνους, πολεμοκάπηλους τυχοδιωκτισμούς των αστικών τάξεων σε Ελλάδα-Τουρκία, που απειλούν και τους δύο λαούς με στρατιωτική σύγκρουση.


Την ίδια στιγμή, για εργαζόμενους, νέους, φτωχά λαϊκά στρώματα περισσεύουν μόνο θυσίες.

Δισεκατομμύρια κατευθύνονται σε εξοπλισμούς, ενώ οι μισθοί εξανεμίζονται από την ακρίβεια, τα νοίκια, τους λογαριασμούς. Υγεία, Παιδεία, υπηρεσίες υποβαθμίζονται, οι ιδιωτικοποιήσεις απλώνονται παντού, τα εργασιακά δικαιώματα τσακίζονται.

 Η πολεμική οικονομία συμβαδίζει με τη φοροληστεία και την καταστολή: θέλουν τους εργαζόμενους να πληρώνουν, να σιωπούν και να πολεμούν για ξένα συμφέροντα και για να επιβάλουν αυτή την πορεία, χτυπούν τις κινητοποιήσεις και τους αγωνιστές, περιορίζουν τις ελευθερίες και ενισχύουν τους μηχανισμούς καταστολής.


ΩΣ ΕΔΩ!

 Η απάντηση δεν βρίσκεται σε ευχολόγια ούτε στην αναμονή κάποιας «ειρηνικής» συμφωνίας των ισχυρών. Βρίσκεται στην ανεξάρτητη δράση των εργαζόμενων, της νεολαίας και των φτωχών λαϊκών στρωμάτων: στα σωματεία, στους χώρους δουλειάς, στις σχολές και στις γειτονιές.

Με οδηγό τους αγώνες και την κοινωνική έκρηξη στη Γαλλία και στην υπόλοιπη Ευρώπη να οικοδομήσουμε ένα μαζικό, μαχητικό, διεθνιστικό αντιπολεμικό και αντιιμπεριαλιστικό κίνημα, με απεργίες, διαδηλώσεις και κοινή δράση των λαών. Να ανατρέψουμε την κυβέρνηση και τις νεοφιλελεύθερες πολιτικές της φτώχειας, του πολέμου και της καταστολής.

 Αγώνας ενάντια στον πόλεμο σημαίνει αγώνας για ψωμί, αξιοπρέπεια και δημοκρατικά δικαιώματα. Διεκδικούμε αυξήσεις σε μισθούς και συντάξεις, δημόσια δωρεάν Υγεία και Παιδεία, κοινωνικό έλεγχο στους τομείς της οικονομίας. Παλεύουμε για μια Κυβέρνηση των Εργαζομένων, για μια σοσιαλιστική κοινωνία χωρίς εκμετάλλευση και πολέμους.


ΕΞΩ ΟΙ ΒΑΣΕΙΣ – ΕΞΩ ΑΠΟ ΤΟ ΝΑΤΟ!


ΚΑΜΙΑ ΣΥΜΜΕΤΟΧΗ ΣΤΟΝ ΠΟΛΕΜΟ


ΕΛΛΑΔΑ – ΤΟΥΡΚΙΑ, ΚΟΙΝΟΣ ΑΓΩΝΑΣ ΤΩΝ ΛΑΩΝ

title: The anarchy of power
content:
Pier Paolo Pasolini,

Salò

,

or the 120 Days of Sodom

 (1976)


Nothing is more anarchic than power. Power does what it wants and what it wants is totally arbitrary or dictated by its economic reasons which escape common logic.


…


Power is always a codifier and ritual. But [that] which ritualizes [,that] which codifies, is always nothingness, pure will, that is, its own anarchy.

China-Russia-U.S. Heads of State Declaration toward Peace


Xi Jinping, President of the People’s Republic of China, Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation, and Donald J. author: Shireen Akram-Boshar
title: The Flatbush Building Collapse Is a Window Into Gentrification in Brooklyn
content:
Activists say the collapse was due to “a series of decisions that placed the profit model over the lives of the people.”

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

On the afternoon of November 11, a three-story building in Flatbush, Brooklyn, collapsed into an adjacent construction site. 1321 Flatbush Avenue — which hosted four apartment units and a store on its ground floor — collapsed within seconds, as did the wall of the neighboring building, exposing its interior.

The collapse killed eight people, all of them immigrants under the age of 32, two of them young children. Among those killed were people born in Guinea, Ecuador, Guatemala, and Colombia. Dozens more were injured and displaced.

The site of the collapse is one of negligence and oversight — the developer of the construction site is known for violating orders and failing to put in place safety precautions, and the adjacent building accumulated at least 98 housing code violations before its collapse. While the construction site had been approved for a three-story building, developers were seeking to build a nine-story building with 64 residential units.

But these violations are part of a larger story, local organizers say. The collapse comes as Flatbush, which is largely Black, with significant Haitian, Afro-Caribbean, and Latino communities, faces a gentrification and displacement crisis that has intensified over the past 15 years. And it’s not just Flatbush: Since 2010, nearly 70,000 Black people have been displaced from Brooklyn, historically a center for Black New Yorkers.

Gentrification — and the city’s decades of neglect of Black and immigrant neighborhoods — is at the heart of this tragedy, one organizer told Truthout.

“We, as Black and brown people, have been feeling the brunt of gentrification in our communities — it is permanent, involuntary displacement,” said Imani Henry of Equality for Flatbush, which has been organizing around issues like gentrification, police violence, and tenants’ rights in Brooklyn since 2013.

“We are constantly dealing with new luxury developments being built in our neighborhoods, and the complete and utter neglect” of buildings where Black and brown people live, with “the infrastructure crumbling and landlords doing nothing,” Henry said. “That’s our norm.”

He pointed to the collapse of a building in the Bronx in December 2023, which displaced 140 New Yorkers, most of them working class, Latino, Caribbean, and Black.

This latest building collapse reveals “the conditions that people in Flatbush have been living under for the last 15 years. We are dealing with slumlords,” as well as “landlords calling ICE” on their tenants, Henry said.

Yasmine Tiana, an activist from the Palaver Collective, which has been organizing in response to the collapse, told Truthout that the tragedy raises the question: “What is more important — the lives of people and families who live within these buildings and apartments, or developers, whose main goal is profit?”

“We can’t pretend this happened in a vacuum,” Tiana said. “It was a series of decisions that placed the profit model over the lives of the people, and now there’s eight people gone. The landlord knew about [the violations], but continued to neglect them.”

Angelina Landress, an organizer with the 75 Lenox Road Tenant Association, told Truthout that her building in Flatbush has hundreds of violations. Her union has been on rent strike for four months due to dangerous conditions and management’s neglect of the property.

Landress disputed the narrative that buildings are falling apart because they’re old, instead citing neglect and deregulation, often of previously rent-stabilized buildings.

Landlords buy up buildings in Flatbush and “don’t put any money into it, collect all the rent, make the conditions sub-par, and drive people out,” Landress said.

Among other problems, landlords are falsely stating they have fixed the problems in their buildings, she added. The tenants of 75 Lenox Road are organizing because they realize they “cannot let the system tell us that we have to follow the current process, because the current process will kill us, just like it killed our neighbors.”

When Truthout reached out to the management of 75 Lenox Road for comment, an office manager who went by Esther and declined to give her last name stated that the tenants association is “just 10 people looking to make trouble.” …

author: Jake Johnson
title: 15 Democrats Join GOP to Pass Big Oil-Backed Permitting Bill in the Senate
content:
The bill would weaken environmental protections to fast-track approvals for data centers and fossil fuel projects.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

The Republican-controlled US Senate, with the support of more than a dozen Democrats, passed a hotly contested bill that would weaken the Clean Water Act, the Endangered Species Act, and other key environmental laws to accelerate approval and development of energy projects, including climate-wrecking gas pipelines and data centers.

The final vote on the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) was 62-33, with nearly every Republican and 15 Democrats supporting passage. The 15 members of the Senate Democratic caucus who voted for the bill were Chris Coons (Del.), John Fetterman (Pa.), Ruben Gallego (Ariz.), Martin Heinrich (NM), John Hickenlooper (Colo.), Angus King (Maine), Amy Klobuchar (Minn.), Gary Peters (Mich.), Jack Reed (RI), Jacky Rosen (Nev.), Brian Schatz (Hawaii), Chuck Schumer (NY), Elissa Slotkin (Mich.), Mark Warner (Va.), and Sheldon Whitehouse (RI).

The legislation passed without ever facing a hearing in the Senate, a fact that Sen. Jeff Merkley (D-Ore.) — an outspoken opponent of the bill — called “pretty damn outrageous and offensive.”

If passed by the House and signed into law by President Donald Trump — whose White House has backed the measure — BAAJA would limit the authority of federal courts to block energy projects due to violations of environmental protection laws. The measure would also exempt pipeline expansions from National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) review, potentially bar future administrations from rolling back previously approved projects, and restrict states’ and tribes’ ability to block projects under the Clean Water Act.

The legislation was endorsed by the American Petroleum Institute, the largest fossil fuel industry lobbying organization in the US. The group applauded Thursday’s vote as “a major breakthrough on historic permitting reforms” and praised the legislation’s lead sponsors, including Whitehouse and Sen. Mike Lee (R-Utah).

Environmental organizations expressed support for some elements of the legislation, such as provisions that would speed up transmission and grid modernization. But the good provisions don’t outweigh the destructive ones, green groups said, arguing the bill’s benefits are heavily tilted toward fossil fuel projects — and would likely be further tilted in that direction by the Big Oil-friendly Trump administration.

“Senators who voted for this bill should be ashamed,” said Erich Pica, president of Friends of the Earth US. “Just weeks after Americans made clear they are tired of politicians putting corporate profits ahead of people, the Senate approved a giant giveaway to Big Tech and polluters. Calling this a bipartisan compromise doesn’t change what it is: a reckless attack on our clean air, clean water, wildlife, public lands, oceans, and communities.”

“It’s bad enough that Republicans wanted to gut our environmental laws,” Pica added. “It’s unconscionable that Democrats helped them do it.”

Some Democrats who supported advancing the bill in previous procedural votes switched their votes to no on final passage, including Sen. Andy Kim (NJ). In a statement posted to social media, Kim said he “voted earlier in the process to allow a debate and amendment process that could improve the bill before final passage.”

“Unfortunately those improvements, which would rein in the worst impulses of the Trump administration, were not made, and the potential consequences for New Jersey are unacceptable,” said Kim.

BAAJA’s opponents called on the House, which will be narrowly controlled by Republicans until January, to reject the legislation.

“This bill identified the wrong problems and has therefore arrived at the wrong solutions,” said David Watkins, director of federal government relations for the Climate and Energy Programs at the Union of Concerned Scientists. “The Clean Water Act isn’t the problem — the fossil fuel industry and their enablers in the Trump administration are responsible for throttling renewable energy deployment across the United States.”

“The Senate’s bill is totally out of step with the message of the midterm elections. Policymakers must move on from the status quo driving high energy bills and record fossil fuel profits,” Watkins added. “The House …

content:

!


La cantine Le Chaud Bouillon se mobilise pour soutenir le projet de rachat d'une ferme en Île-de-France par les associations A4 et Ciwara.


Dans le cadre de cette transmission d'une ferme bio de 17 ha cultivés sans intrants ni irrigation, l'association Ciwara doit réunir les fonds pour acheter le matériel agricole de cette ferme maraîchère située à Marcoussis (Essonne) et y implanter un lieu d'insertion, d'expérimentation et de formation avec l'association A4.


A4 asso oeuvre en France depuis plusieurs années pour favoriser l'insertion professionnelle des personnes en parcours d'exil dans des emplois agricoles et artisanaux. Le rachat de cette ferme bio dans l'Essonne représente pour A4 la première possibilité d'implanter un projet d'agroécologie solidaire pérenne.

author: Software Architektur im Stream
title: Produktivität mit KI: Das Harvard-Paper
content:
Wie viel schneller werden Entwickler:innen durch den Einsatz von KI? Viele Studien untersuchen vor allem, wie stark KI das Coding beschleunigt. Doch schnellerer Code bedeutet nicht automatisch mehr Produktivität. Entscheidend ist letztlich, ob tatsächlich mehr sinnvolle Features entstehen und bei den Kunden ankommen.


Die

Harvard-Studie

 hat Daten von 720.542 Entwicklern aus 655 Firmen ausgewertet und dabei mehr als nur die Coding-Leistung bewertet. In dieser Folge erläutert Eberhard die Ergebnisse der Studie an und diskutieren sie. Was lässt sich aus den Zahlen tatsächlich ableiten? Und was sagen sie über den Produktivitätsgewinn durch KI in der Software-Entwicklung aus?

author: Joshua Carroll
title: Irish Police Buy Israeli Anti-Drone Technology
content:
Ireland’s police force has purchased anti-drone signal-jamming technology from an Israeli firm despite a government pledge to block such deals.


The force bought the equipment earlier this year from Tel Aviv-based company Sentrycs, and has now mounted the jammers on buildings hosting events for Ireland’s presidency of the EU,

the Journal revealed

.


Ireland’s taoiseach Micheál Martin had previously pledged that the government

would no longer procure

 “military equipment or defence equipment or contracts with Israel”, stating in 2024: “That certainly will not happen.”


Yet the Irish national police went ahead with purchasing the anti-drone technology earlier this year, with the equipment now mounted on roofs to prevent drones flying over buildings during meetings.


Sentrycs, which was acquired by US-based Ondas Holdings in November 2025, supplies counter-drone technology to numerous weapons companies, including Israel’s Elbit Systems, which has played a major role in supplying weapons used in the genocide in Gaza.


Its board includes several former IDF members, the Journal reported, noting that CEO Tal Cohen worked as head of product and research and development for the Israeli Air Force from 2016 to 2020.


The Journal reported in January 2025 that

four new helicopters being built

 for the Irish Air Corps would have Israeli-manufactured technology on board.


This July, Irish president Catherine Connolly signed a

ban on the import of Israeli goods

 from the occupied Palestinian territories. Irish businesses can no longer legally import goods produced in Israeli settlements in the West Bank and East Jerusalem, with customs officers given powers to stop and seize restricted goods at the border.


However, businesses will still be able to import goods produced within Israel’s internationally recognised borders.

title: ᓄᓇᕗᒥᑦ ᐊᕙᑎᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᖏᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᓕᐅᕆᓇᓱᒃᑐᑦ ᐃᖃᓗᐃᑦ ᓄᒃᑭᒃᓴᐅᑎᒃᑯᓐᓂ ᐱᒋᐊᖁᔨᕗᑦ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᐊᖅᑕᐅᓚᐅᙱᑎᓪᓗᒍ
content:
For the English version of this story, please see

.


ᕿᑭᖅᑕᓂ ᐃᓄᐃᑦ ᑲᑐᔾᔨᖃᑎᒌᖏᑦ “ᐃᓱᒪᒃᓴᖅᓯᐅᕈᑎᖃᖅᑐᑦ ᑭᖑᓪᓕᕐᒥ ᖃᓄᐃᓕᐅᕈᑎᒃᓴᓂᒃ” ᐅᑯᐊ ᓄᓇᕗᒥ ᐊᕙᑎᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᖏᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᓕᐅᕆᓇᓱᓚᐅᖅᑎᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᐅᓇ ᐃᖃᓗᖕᓂ ᓄᒃᑭᒃᓴᐅᑎᒃᓴᒧᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᒃᓴᖅ ᓯᕗᒧᑦ ᐱᒋᐊᖁᓚᐅᓪᓗᓂ ᐃᓄᖕᓄᑦ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᐊᖅᑕᐅᙱᒃᑲᓗᐊᕐᓗᓂ.


“ᓯᕗᓪᓕᐅᑎᓯᒪᓇᓱᒃᑕᕗᑦ ᐅᓇ ᐱᕙᓪᓕᐊᑎᑦᑎᓂᖅᒥᒃ ᓄᑖᒥ ᓄᒃᑭᒃᓴᐅᑎᒃᓴᒧᑦ ᐃᓂᒃᓴᐅᓂᐊᕐᑐᖅ ᓯᕗᒧᑦ ᐱᒋᐊᖁᓪᓗᑎᒍᑦ ᐅᓇ ᐃᓄᐃᑦ ᐱᔪᓐᓇᐅᑎᖃᕐᓂᖏᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᒋᔭᐅᓗᓂ,” ᑎᑎᕋᖅᓯᒪᔪᓃᑦᑐᖅ ᐅᕙᙵᑦ ᕿᑭᖅᑕᓂ ᐃᓄᐃᑦ ᑲᑐᔾᔨᖃᑎᒌᑦ ᐅᖃᖅᑎᖓᓂ ᒫᑰᓯ ᖃᐅᕐᓂᖅ, ᑎᑎᕋᖅᑕᕕᓂᖏᓐᓂ ᓄᕕᐱᕆ 10-ᒥ.


ᐅᓇ $500 ᒥᓕᐊᓐᑐᕐᑐᖅ ᐃᖃᓗᖕᓂ ᓄᒃᑭᒃᓴᐅᑎᒧᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᒃᓴᖅ, ᒫᓐᓇᓕ ᖃᓄᐃᓕᖓᓂᐊᕐᓂᖓ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓱᖅᑕᐅᕙᓪᓕᐊᓪᓗᓂ, ᑐᒃᓯᕋᐅᓯᐅᖅᑕᐅᓯᒪᔪᖅ ᐅᑯᓇᙵᑦ ᓄᓇᕗᑦ ᓄᒃᑭᒃᓴᐅᑏᑦ ᑯᐊᐳᕇᓴᓐᑯᓐᓂ, ᐃᓚᒋᔭᐅᔪᖅ ᕿᑭᖅᑖᓗᒃ ᑯᐊᐳᕇᓴᓐᑯᓐᓄ, ᑖᒃᑯᐊᓗ ᕿᑭᖅᑕᓂ ᐃᓄᐃᑦ ᑲᑐᔾᔨᖃᑎᒌᓄᑦ ᐱᕙᓪᓕᐊᔪᓕᕆᓪᓗᓂᔾᔪᒃ.


ᐊᖏᖅᑕᐅᒍᓂ ᓴᓇᓯᒋᐊᕐᓂᐊᖅᑐᑦ ᓄᒃᑭᒃᓴᐅᑎᖃᖅᕕᒃᓴᒥ ᑰᖕᒥᙶᖅᑐᒥ ᐃᒪᕐᒧᑦ ᓴᖏᓂᖃᓕᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ 30 ᒥᒐᕗᐊᑦᔅ ᐅᕙᓂ ᑰᒑᓗᒃ ᑰᖕᒥᑦ, ᑖᓐᓇᓗ 60 ᑭᓛᒥᐊᓂ ᐅᖓᓯᖕᓂᖃᖅᖢᓂ ᐅᐊᖕᓇᖓᑕ ᑲᓇᖕᓇᖅᐸᓯᐊᓂ ᐃᖃᓗᐃᑦ. ᐃᓚᖃᖅᑎᑕᐅᓂᐊᖅᑐᖅ 7,136 ᕼᐊᒃᑎᐊ ᐃᒪᖃᖅᕕᒃᒥ ᐊᒻᒪᓗ 66 ᑭᓛᒥᑕ ᐊᖅᑯᑎᐅᓂᐊᖅᑐᒥᑦ.


ᑖᓐᓇ ᑲᒻᐸᓂᐅᔪᖅ ᐅᖃᕐᓯᒪᔪᖅ ᓄᒃᑭᒃᓴᐅᑎᖃᕐᕕᒃᓴᖅ ᐃᓇᖏᕐᓯᓇᔭᕐᓂᖓᓂ 15 ᒥᓕᐊᓐ ᓖᑕᓂ ᐅᕐᓱᐊᓗᒃ ᑏᓱᒥ ᐊᕐᕌᒍᑕᒫᓐ ᐆᒻᒪᖅᑯᑎᖃᕐᕕᒃᒧᑦ ᐊᑐᖅᑕᐅᕙᒃᑐᒥ.


ᓄᕕᐱᕆ 2025-ᒥ ᑲᓇᑕᒧᑦ ᐊᖓᔪᖅᑳᖅ ᒫᒃ ᑳᓂ “ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐃᑲᔫᑎ” ᐱᓕᕆᐊᒃᓴᖅ ᐊᖏᖅᑕᐅᓵᓕᑲᑕᖁᓪᓗᓂᐅᒃ. ᑕᐃᒪᓐᓇᓕ ᓴᓇᔭᐅᕙᓪᓕᐊᓕᕋᔭᖅᑐᖅ 2028-ᒥ – ᐊᕐᕌᒎᖕᓂ ᒪᕐᕉᖕᓂ ᓯᕗᕙᕆᐊᕐᓯᒪᓂᕐᓴᐅᓗᓂ ᐃᓱᒪᒋᔭᐅᖅᑳᓚᐅᖅᑐᒥᓐ.


ᓄᕕᐱᕆ 4-ᒥ ᓄᓇᕗᒥᑦ ᐊᕙᑎᓕᕆᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᖏᑦ ᑎᑎᕋᐅᓯᖃᓚᐅᕐᒪᑕ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᐊᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᓕᐊᖏᓐᓂ ᐅᓂᒃᑳᓂ, ᐅᖃᕐᓯᒪᓪᓗᑎᒃ ᑐᒃᓯᕋᐅᑎᒋᔭᐅᔪᖅ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᐊᖅᑕᐅᙱᒃᑲᓗᐊᖅᐸᑦ ᓱᖁᑕᐅᒋᔭᐅᙱᓐᓂᕋᖅᖢᒍ ᐊᒻᒪᓗ ᖃᐅᔨᑎᑕᐅᓪᓗᓂ ᒥᓂᔅᑕᒧᑦ ᐅᑭᐅᕐᑕᖅᑐᕐᒥ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐅᑭᐅᕐᑕᖅᑐᕐᒥ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᒃᓴᓕᕆᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐅᓖᐱᑲ ᓵᑐᕋᓐ, ᑖᓐᓇᓕ ᑕᒪᑐᒧᖓ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᓪᓚᕆᒐᔭᖅᖢᓂ ᐃᓱᒪᓕᐊᕆᔭᐅᓯᒪᔪᒧᑦ. ᑲᑎᒪᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖃᑦᑕᕐᒪᑕ ᐃᓅᖃᑎᒌᖕᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᕙᓪᓕᐊᔪᓕᕆᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐊᒃᑐᐃᒍᑎᐅᓇᔭᕐᑐᖅ ᐊᒻᒪ ᑐᓴᖅᑎᑦᑎᓗᓂ ᒐᕙᒪᑐᖃᒃᑯᓐᓂ ᑖᓐᓇ ᒥᓂᔅᑕ ᑲᔪᓯᑎᑦᑎᖁᔨᓂᖓ ᒪᓕᒃᑕᐅᓇᔭᕆᐊᒃᓴᖓᓂ.


ᑲᑎᒪᔩ ᐱᔾᔪᑎᖃᕐᒪᑕᓕ ᖃᓄᐃᓕᒍᑎᐅᓇᔭᕐᑐᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᑕᐅᓯᒪᔪᓐᓇᕐᓂᖏᓐᓄᑦ ᐊᑐᓕᕆᐊᓕᒃᑎᒍᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᒪᓕᒋᐊᓕᒃᑎᒎᖓᔪᓂᒃ ᐊᒻᒪᓗ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᒃᓴᖅ ᐃᒪᐃᙱᖢᓂ “ᐃᓚᖃᖅᑎᑦᑎᓂᕐᒥ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᑎᓄᑦ ᖃᓄᐃᓕᐅᕈᑎᐅᓇᔭᖅᑐᓂ ᐊᒻᒪᓗ ᑖᓐᓇ ᖃᓄᒻᒪᕆᒃ ᐊᑐᕐᓂᐊᕆᐊᒃᓴᖓᓂ ᓇᓗᓇᖅᖢᓂ,” ᐅᖃᕐᓯᒪᔪᐃᑦ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᐊᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐅᓂᒃᑳᑦ.


ᕿᑭᖅᑕᓂ ᐃᓄᐃᑦ ᑲᑐᔾᔨᖃᑎᒌᖏᑦ ᑭᐅᓗᒍᑎᖃᓚᐅᕐᑐᑦ ᐊᒃᑐᐃᔾᔪᑎᒋᓇᔭᖅᑕᖏᑦ ᐱᐅᓯᕚᓪᓕᕈᑎᐅᓇᓱᒃᑐ ᓇᓗᓇᕐᓂᖏᓐᓂ, ᐱᓗᐊᖅᑐᒥ ᐃᖃᓗᖕᓄᑦ (fish), ᐆᒪᔪᓄᑦ ᑕᒪᐅᓈᖅᐸᒃᑐᓄᑦ, ᓄᓇᐅᑉ ᐊᑖᓂ ᓯᑯᑐᖃᕐᒥ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐊᖑᓇᓱᖃᑦᑕᕐᓂᕐᒥᒃ.


ᓵᑐᕋᓐ ᐅᓪᓗᕐᓂ 150 ᐃᓗᐊᓂ ᑭᐅᔭᕆᐊᖃᕐᓂᐊᖅᑐᖅ.


ᑕᐃᒪᐃᓐᓂᖓᓂᓕ ᐃᓄᐃᑦ ᑲᑐᔾᔨᖃᑎᒌᖏᑦ ᐸᕐᓇᐅᓯᐅᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᖕᒪᑕ ᓄᓇᓖᑦ ᐅᑯᐊ ᐃᖃᓗᐃᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐸᓐᓂᕐᑑᖅ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᖕᓂᒃᓴᖏᓐᓂ, ᑐᓴᒐᒃᓴᕆᔭᐅᔪᖅ ᐅᖃᕐᓯᒪᔪᖅ.


ᖃᐅᕐᓂᖅ ᑭᐅᓚᐅᙱᒻᒪ ᑕᒪᑐᒧᖓ ᑐᓴᕐᕕᐅᒋᐊᒃᑲᓐᓂᕋᓱᒃᖢᓂ ᐅᑯᐊᓗ ᕿᒥᕐᕈᔨᒃᑯᑦ ᑲᑎᒪᔨᖏᑦ.

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Feijóo no ganó ningún debate: mentir, embarrar y deshumanizar es todo lo que tiene.
content:
Para alguien como Feijóo, y para la ultraderecha en general, en un debate vale todo. Los datos se inventan, las mentiras se sueltan sin despeinarse, la educación sobra y no dejar hablar al contrario es lo normal. Eso es debatir para esta gente: lo mismo que hace un borracho en un bar, que no escucha, grita más fuerte y cree que tiene razón porque el otro se ha callado.


¿Ganar es mentir?


Después de cada cita de este tipo aparece el coro de siempre preguntando si Feijóo ganó. Y yo me pregunto qué clase de victoria es esa. Mentir, dar datos falsos, ser maleducado, interrumpir y no cumplir las normas pactadas… Parece que para algunos eso es ganar. Si ganar consiste en saltarse las reglas, entonces también gana quien hace trampas al mus y se queda con el bote. Pero no, eso no es ganar: eso es no tener vergüenza.


Un debate es un intercambio de argumentos, datos y propuestas ante la ciudadanía. Quien miente, interrumpe y atropella a su adversario no debate: huye del debate, porque sabe que, con argumentos y con la verdad por delante, no tiene nada que ofrecer a la clase trabajadora.


El cerdo en su barro


Feijóo es como los cerdos: se encuentra cómodo revolcándose en el barro. Lo suyo es jugar sucio, embarrar al de enfrente para que todo el escenario quede perdido y nadie sepa ya quién dice la verdad. Es un político de estercolero y en el estercolero se mueve como en casa. Cuanto más bajo es el nivel, más a gusto está; cuanto más limpio es el debate, más se le notan las carencias.


El dolor ajeno como munición


Y cuando no queda más barro, tira del dolor de los demás. El uso y la deshumanización de las víctimas de accidentes y catástrofes, de los migrantes o de la familia del contrincante es lo único que alguien como Feijóo tiene que ofrecer. Una tragedia no es para él un motivo para ayudar a las familias, sino una oportunidad para rentabilizarla: las víctimas sirven de arma arrojadiza contra el Gobierno y, cuando dejan de servir, se olvidan.


Con los migrantes, lo mismo. Gente que huye de la guerra, del hambre, de la miseria y de las dictaduras es presentada como una amenaza o un problema de seguridad. Deshumanizar al más débil es la vieja receta de la derecha y la ultraderecha para que los de abajo se peleen entre sí mientras los de arriba siguen cobrando y mandando. Y cuando se les acaban los argumentos, que es siempre, tiran de la familia del adversario, porque quien necesita meterse con la mujer o los hijos del otro no tiene nada que decir sobre el trabajo, la vivienda, las pensiones o la sanidad.


Sin empatía, sin honestidad y sin dignidad


Su proyecto se basa en lo peor del ser humano y en una absoluta falta de empatía, honestidad y dignidad. No es un accidente ni una mala noche: es un método. Y es el método de todo su partido. El PP siempre se salta lo pactado y hace trampas; no conoce la honestidad. Cuando acuerda unas reglas es para incumplirlas; cuando firma un pacto es para romperlo, y luego va de víctima. Son unos auténticos sinvergüenzas, del primero al último, y conviene decirlo sin rodeos, porque la educación que ellos no tienen no puede servirnos de excusa para callar lo evidente.


Quien trata así a las víctimas, a los migrantes y a las familias de los demás no nos va a tratar mejor a los trabajadores y a las trabajadoras cuando le toque recortar nuestros derechos.


Mi voto está decidido: jamás seré un fachapobre


Yo lo tengo claro y mi voto está decidido. Jamás seré un fachapobre: ese trabajador que vota a quien lo desprecia, le recorta derechos, lo despide barato y lo manda a trabajar enfermo mientras aplaude a quien lo insulta desde un atril. No me engaño: la democracia burguesa no es la solución, y quienes militamos en la izquierda de clase lo sabemos mejor que nadie. Pero que no sea la solución no quiere decir que dé igual quién gobierne. La ultraderecha es el desastre, un suicidio para los trabajadores y las trabajadoras: la sanidad, las pensiones, los salarios y los derechos laborales pagan siempre la factura.


Primero hay que frenar al fascismo y a quienes le abren la puerta; después, organizarse y construir la alternativa que esta clase trabajadora merece. Pero que nadie espere que dé por ganador a quien hace trampas, miente y chilla. Ni en un debate, ni en las urnas, ni en la vida.


¡Até a vitoria sempre!


André Abeledo Fernández

author: Mag
title: ver.di fordert entschlossenes Vorgehen gegen prekäre und krankmachende Arbeitsbedingungen in der Paketbranche
content:
Dossier


„Am 10. Dezember 2021 fand eine Pressekonferenz in der ver.di-Bundesverwaltung statt, gemeinsam mit den Gesamtbetriebsratsvorsitzenden der fünf großen KEP-Dienstleister (DPD, UPS, Hermes, FedEx und DHL). (…) „Kontrollen des Zolls belegen Sozialversicherungsbetrug, Unterschreiten des Mindestlohns, Schwarzarbeit und illegale Beschäftigung sowie systematischen Betrug an Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmern, die bei Subunternehmen beschäftigt sind und häufig aus Osteuropa kommen.“ Solchen Formen der organisierten Kriminalität sei nur mit verstärkten Kontrollen und schärferen gesetzlichen Regelungen beizukommen. So müsse die Nachunternehmerhaftung für die Sozialversicherungsbeiträge auf die gesamte Logistik-Branche ausgeweitet werden (…) Die Tarifbindung in der Branche müsse durch Tariftreuegesetze gestärkt werden. Zum Schutz der Zustellerinnen und Zusteller vor zunehmender physischer Belastung sei eine Kennzeichnung schwerer Pakete notwendig; zudem müsse deren zulässiges Gewicht auf 20 Kilogramm begrenzt werden…“


ver.di-Pressemitteilung vom 10. Dezember 2021

 

, siehe dazu:


Montag, 23. November 2026 in Berlin: Protest mit Riesenpaket zum Beginn der Black Week als belastendster und arbeitsreichster Zeit in der Paketbranche


„

ver.di-Protest mit Riesenpaket zur Arbeitsbelastung in der Paketbranche

mit dem Beginn der Black Week in der nächsten Woche startet für die Beschäftigten in der Paketbranche die arbeitsreichste und belastendste Zeit des Jahres. Millionen zusätzlicher Sendungen sorgen für steigenden Zeitdruck und noch höhere körperliche Belastungen. Schwere Pakete gehören für Paketzustellerinnen und -zustellern zum Alltag. Obwohl der Koalitionsvertrag die 20-Kilogramm-Grenze für Pakete in der Ein-Personen-Zustellung vorsieht, fehlt bis heute die notwendige Umsetzung durch die Bundesregierung.


Mit einer öffentlichen Aktion am Montag, 23. November 2026, ab 11:00 Uhr am Pariser Platz, vor dem Brandenburger Tor in Berlin fordern Beschäftigte der Kurier-, Express- und Paketbranche gemeinsam mit der Vereinten Dienstleistungsgewerkschaft (ver.di) die Bundesregierung auf, endlich zu handeln. Ein überdimensionales Paket vor dem Brandenburger Tor setzt dabei ein sichtbares Zeichen für die Forderung nach einer verbindlichen 20-Kilogramm-Grenze.


Im Mittelpunkt der Aktion stehen die Erfahrungen und Forderungen der Beschäftigten. An einem Mitmach-Parcours werden die körperlichen Belastungen der Paketzustellung sichtbar gemacht. title: Make Amazon Pay zum Black Friday 2026 am 27.-30. November: Bezos und Trump gestalten eine techno-autoritäre Zukunft – doch die Menschen wehren sich.
content:
„

Seit sechs Jahren schließen sich Arbeitnehmer*innen und Bewegungen weltweit zusammen, um Amazon zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen. Am Black Friday, dem 27. November 2026, werden wir uns erneut gemeinsam für angemessene Löhne, sichere Arbeitsbedingungen, Gewerkschaftsrechte, faire Besteuerung, Klimagerechtigkeit und Freiheit von Unternehmensüberwachung und Krieg einsetzen. Macht mit. Werdet aktiv. Zieht Amazon zur Rechenschaft

…“ diesjähriger engl.

Aufruf von Make Amazon Pay campaign


 mit Aktionskarte zum weltweiten Aktionstag, den Gewerkschaften, zivilgesellschaftliche Organisationen und Umweltverbände am „Black Friday“, dem 27. November mit Streiks und Protesten in mehr als 20 Ländern planen:


Im Vorfeld des Black Friday 2026 appellieren Gewerkschaften in 19 Ländern öffentliche Aufträge an UnionBuster Amazon und Amazon Web Services (AWS) zu stoppen


Gewerkschaften in 19 Ländern an die Regierungen: Hört auf, Amazon öffentliche Gelder zu gewähren, solange das Unternehmen die Arbeitnehmerrechte verletzt


„

Gewerkschaftsführer aus 19 Ländern, die Millionen von Arbeitnehmern vertreten, haben die Regierungen aufgefordert, keine öffentlichen Aufträge mehr an Amazon und Amazon Web Services (AWS) zu vergeben, nachdem US-Bundesbehörden im vergangenen Jahr mehr als 3,5 Milliarden US-Dollar an AWS vergeben hatten.

Der Brief


 wurde im Vorfeld des Black Friday veröffentlicht, dem umsatzstärksten Einkaufstag für den E-Commerce-Riesen, den Gewerkschaften und die Zivilgesellschaft in „

Make Amazon Pay Day

“

 umbenannt haben – einen jährlichen weltweiten Tag der Streiks und Proteste, um Amazon für seine Arbeitspraktiken, Umweltauswirkungen und Steuerpolitik zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen.


In einem von UNI Global Union koordinierten offenen Brief warnen die Vorsitzenden von 32 Gewerkschaften davor, dass Regierungen zunehmend von einem Unternehmen abhängig werden, das seit langem und nachweislich die Grundrechte der Beschäftigten verletzt. Der Brief dokumentiert diese Praxis auch außerhalb der Vereinigten Staaten: In Deutschland hat Amazon trotz mehr als eines Jahrzehnts von Streiks Tarifverhandlungen verweigert; in Quebec stellte das Unternehmen seinen Betrieb vollständig ein, als sich die Beschäftigten organisierten, wodurch Tausende ihren Arbeitsplatz verloren.


Die Gewerkschaften fordern die Regierungen auf, alle bestehenden und geplanten Verträge mit Amazon und AWS zu überprüfen, die Achtung der Grundrechte der Arbeitnehmer zu einer zwingenden Voraussetzung für die Vertragsvergabe zu machen und Unternehmen, die diese Rechte verletzen, von künftigen öffentlichen Ausschreibungen auszuschließen. (…)


Im

Vereinigten Königreich

MwSt.) und bezeichnete diesen als „Verlängerung der AWS-Public-Cloud-Dienste“. Am 5. und 6. November, nachdem in der Fachpresse über die Pläne berichtet worden war, änderte es die Ausschreibung, um den Verweis auf AWS zu entfernen und anzugeben, dass der Auftrag im Rahmen des G-Cloud-Rahmenprogramms der Regierung ausgeschrieben werde. AWS dürfte den Auftrag erhalten, berichtete „The Register“. Im gleichen Zeitraum hat Amazon das Recht seiner Beschäftigten auf gewerkschaftliche Organisation vor Gericht angefochten. Das Unternehmen argumentierte, die Struktur der National Labor Relations Board sei verfassungswidrig, um das von den Teamsters angestrengte Verfahren zu stoppen – ein Vorbringen, das der Ninth Circuit zurückwies. Im Juni entschied ein Richter der Arbeitsbehörde, dass Amazon gegen Bundesrecht verstoßen habe, indem es sich weigerte, die Teamsters in einem Lieferzentrum in San Francisco anzuerkennen, wo die Beschäftigten mehrheitlich dafür gestimmt hatten.


In

Quebec

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Bill C-10 becomes law, creates modern treaty watchdog
content:
A federal bill to create an independent watchdog to monitor Canada’s implementation of modern treaties was passed into law Thursday.


The Land Claims Agreements Coalition welcomed the news, calling it “an important step” toward independent oversight of modern treaties, which are agreements between Indigneous Peoples and the government since 1975.


“For more than 20 years, Inuit and other Modern Treaty partners have called for independent oversight of our agreements. Today, we have taken an important step toward making that a reality,” Gloria Uluqsi, the organization’s co-chair, said in a news release. She is also president of Nunavut Tunngavik Inc. 


The Land Claims Agreement Coalition represents 23 Inuit and First Nations modern treaty holders, including NTI and Makivvik.


Modern treaties, also known as comprehensive land claims agreements signed after 1975, define land and resource rights between Indigenous signatories and the Crown.


The Commissioner for Modern Treaty Implementation Act establishes an independent commissioner who will review federal government activities related to treaty implementation, conduct performance audits and report his or her findings to Parliament.


Federal departments and the auditor general will, however, remain responsible for meeting Canada’s treaty obligations, the news release said.


“The Commissioner will help hold Canada accountable, but the real measure of success will be when those commitments are carried out and make a difference in the lives of our people,” Uluqsi said. 


The legal process for an independent commissioner began under Justin Trudeau’s

Liberal government

 in 2024.


The initiative was in response to decades of calls by Indigenous modern treaty partners for stronger oversight of 26 modern treaties covering more than 600,000 square kilometres.


The federal government committed $10.6 million over four years to support the commissioner, who would consult with Indigenous partners on cultural, linguistic, and resource rights.


Introduced then as Bill C-77, the legislation lapsed when Parliament dissolved in March 2025. Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government reintroduced it after the last federal election as Bill C-10.


The commissioner will serve a seven-year term and will be selected in consultation with modern treaty partners, Indigenous Services Minister Mandy Gull-Masty said in the House of Commons back in February.

author: Rachel Small
title: A Flurry of Media Coverage of WBW’s Reframing Remembrance Day Educators’ Handbook
content:
Armistice-Remembrance Day, Canada, Culture of Peace, North America

By Mark Birnbaum, World BEYOND War, November 20, 2026

In anticipation of Remembrance Day, World BEYOND War created a brand new resource guide to promote the white poppy and its message of recognizing all victims of war: Reframing Remembrance Day: A Handbook for Educators.

Our new resource was covered by multiple Canadian media outlets. Though their articles were framed around the supposed controversy surrounding the use of the white poppy, their coverage nonetheless served to spread our message: abolishing war and recentering Remembrance Day on creating a peaceful future.

The National Post detailed how “…Canadians were confronted before this year’s Remembrance Day with a campaign advocating white pacifist poppies. An anti-war organization known as World Beyond War proposed on Nov. 6, what it called ‘an alternative to traditional, militaristic Remembrance Day education, centred around the White Poppy — a symbol meant to recognize all victims of war.

“‘World BEYOND War’s website messaging is that though Remembrance Day “was founded to abolish war, the way it is marked increasingly serves to glorify war, militarism, and violence. Most concerningly, school curricula across Canada still make the glorification of war and notions of bravery and sacrifice through military violence central to Remembrance Day.”‘”

The article later references commentary in the National Post from 2013: “If anything is clear in the great poppy debate, though, it’s this: the white poppy symbol, like the flower itself, is not native to Flanders as is its red cousin. Accordingly, it has never caught on as a symbol of remembrance. Perhaps major Canadian involvement in recent wars has caused it to blossom anew.”

Indeed, Canadians are growing increasingly angry and restive about Canada’s accelerated militarism.

The Toronto Sun gives an accurate summary of the handbook’s materials for teachers, “…that encourages them to ‘challenge militarism’ in the classroom on Remembrance Day.

“The handbook goes further, encouraging grades 1-3 students to ‘draw your own white poppies or make them from paper plates or cupcake holders. Put these poppies together in a display or garden.’

“It asks grade 4-6 students to ‘explore cultural promotion of war and militarism that surrounds us in our daily lives. This might look like toys sold at local stores, an annual air show … or other media that glorifies war, weapons and violence.’”

With the guide offering ideas for direct, nonviolent political action, the Sun article aptly acknowledges World BEYOND War’s antiwar mandate, “…[as the guide] charges straight into activism, demanding that grades 7-12 students ‘lobby your member of Parliament – get your priorities straight!’”

Students are free to choose from an array of actions based on comfort level and degree of engagement.

An article from Newsweek recounts how, “…Reframing Remembrance Day in Canada: A Handbook for Educators [..] offers teachers an alternative approach to lessons traditionally centered on soldiers, military service and wartime sacrifice.

“Its organizers argue that Remembrance Day should also encourage children to consider the experiences of civilians, the causes of conflict and ways to prevent future wars.

“The materials include age-appropriate activities intended to prompt discussions about peace, violence and the human consequences of armed conflict.

“Rather than simply recounting military history , the campaign encourages teachers to explore the wider effects of war on families, communities and people who never served in uniform.

“Supporters believe that focusing on the experiences of soldiers alone can leave children with an incomplete understanding of conflict.”

Asia, East and Southeast Asia, Law

By World BEYOND War Asia, November 20, 2026

World BEYOND War Asia lauds the International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling on The Gambia v. Myanmar genocide case.

In a 9–6 decision, the ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people. This historic event means that long-overdue justice for the Rohingya has finally been delivered. We extend our warmest solidarity to all Rohingya and the rest of the people of Myanmar who continue to be victimized by the military junta.

We hope this ruling will also serve as a step toward justice for the people of Palestine, who have long suffered at the hands of Israel, and inspire many victims and survivors to stand up and make their voices heard.

WBW Asia reiterates its message: Militarization and war must end now! Violence should never be acceptable anywhere in the world, and perpetrators must be held accountable.

Genuine peace requires justice and accountability.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "A COP of Betrayal": U.N. Talks Make No Progress on Fossil Fuel Phaseout, Climate Finance
content:
In our closing broadcast from Antalya, Turkey, the site of the 31st annual U.N. climate change summit, we take a look at what has — and hasn’t — been accomplished at this latest attempt to reach an international framework to stem the impacts of climate change.


“This

COP

 was being touted as a

COP

 of implementation, but what it has become is a

COP

 of betrayal and a

COP

 of distraction,” laments environmental justice advocate Harjeet Singh, the founding director of India’s Satat Sampada Climate Foundation. He’s joined on

Democracy Now!

 by Meena Raman of Friends of the Earth Malaysia and Nafkote Dabi of Oxfam International as a number of NGOs announce their rejection of the conference’s final declaration text, which contains no mentions of fossil fuels or clear financial commitments from polluter countries.


“At the heart of the negotiations right now lies money,” says Dabi. “What rich countries, especially the EU, [are] saying is, 'There is no money at home.' But we know there’s money. They can tax the richest. They can tax the excess profit of fossil fuel companies. They can tax private jets. They can tax extreme wealth and raise the funds that’s needed to support communities.”

author: Daron Letts
title: Iqaluit family returns to ‘Family Feud Canada,’ earns nail-biter win
content:
Knowledge of the things one must get used to again every winter helped Iqaluit’s Kotierk family win its

second

 appearance on CBC’s

 Family Feud Canada

 on Thursday night.


The episode was titled

$10k Nail-biter

!


“It really was a $10k nail-biter,” said team captain Kunuk Kotierk over messenger, after catching the show with friends and family on Thursday night.


“We had a bigger watch party this time,” he said. “It was fun to see what they kept in and reminisce about the shooting.”


The episode was

recorded

 in Toronto in August.


The game show format sees two families go head-to-head in a race to guess the most popular answers to surveys of 100 people.


The first family to get 300 points wins a chance to compete for $10,000 in the Fast Money round. That’s where two teammates have to beat the clock to earn 200 points as they guess the top answers to five survey questions.


The Kotierk family’s five-person team included David Joanasie, Emily Joanasie, Jessica Kotierk, Aluki Kotierk and Kunuk Kotierk.


Kunuk Kotierk kicked the game off by out-buzzing a member of the Katsoulis family from Scarborough, Ont..


Aluki Kotierk won the second faceoff.


Host Gerry Dee paused the action to ask her what language the family speaks at home.


“In Nunavut, 70 per cent of the population speaks Inuktitut as their mother tongue,” Aluki Kotierk said. “It’s actually the only jurisdiction in Canada where both French and English are the minority languages.”


After a quick lesson in Inuktitut, the family had to guess what survey respondents said they struggle to get used to every winter.


“Especially where we’re from

—

the darkness,” said Emily Joanasie.


It earned the family its first strike.


“Snowmobiles,” said David Joanasie.


That was also a strike.


The family nonetheless managed to win that round and the next.


Kunuk Kotierk and Jessica Kotierk went on to play Fast Money.

Kunuk Kotierk stumbled over an answer and only managed to earn 54 of the 200 points needed for the win.


Jessica Kotierk saved the day with a string of number 1 answers that netted the pair the remaining 146 points, earning the family its second $10,000 prize.


“My friends have been congratulating me,” Kunuk Kotierk said.


The family is scheduled to appear in its third and final episode at 7:30 p.m. on Monday on CBC. It is also watchable on the CBC Gem app.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Historic Judgment": World Court Rules Burma Guilty of Genocide Against Rohingya
content:
The world’s top court has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the country’s Rohingya Muslim minority in a 2017 military crackdown that killed about 10,000 people and drove more than 730,000 refugees into Bangladesh. The landmark ruling is the first time the International Court of Justice has held a nation directly responsible for violating the 1948 Genocide Convention. “This is a vindication of what Rohingyas have been saying for the last almost 50 years, since 1978, when the first wave of genocidal expulsion was conducted by the very same perpetrating institution,” says Burmese dissident scholar Maung Zarni. By recognizing Myanmar’s “identity-based group destruction” of the Royinghas, he says, “the court vindicated [the] Rohingya’s collective articulation, memory and suffering.”


“For the first time in its history, the court has set up a process for restitution and reparation for the members of the Rohingya community,” explains Philippe Sands, an international human rights lawyer who served on the legal team for The Gambia, which first brought the legal case against Myanmar to the

ICJ

 six years ago. Sands discusses next steps for restitution and reparations to Rohingya victims, as well as what the Myanmar judgment means for South Africa’s genocide case against Israel, also before the

ICJ

.

title: Defizite in der Gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung (GKV) als Argument für solidarische Gesundheitsversicherung
content:
Dossier


„

Die Vereinte Dienstleistungsgewerkschaft (ver.di) kritisiert die Pläne von Bundesgesundheitsminister Karl Lauterbach zur Deckung der erwarteten Defizite in der Gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung (GKV), darunter die Erhöhung der kassenindividuellen Zusatzbeiträge der Versicherten um durchschnittlich 0,3 Prozentpunkte, scharf. (…) Das reiche nicht einmal für den Ausgleich der absehbaren pandemiebedingten Mehrausgaben. „Der Bundeszuschuss muss signifikant höher sein als geplant, damit nicht die Versicherten die Zeche zahlen und allerletzte Reserven aufgezehrt werden.“ ver.di fordert, dass der Bund seiner Verantwortung gerecht wird und die versicherungsfremden Leistungen vollständig refinanziert. Dazu gehöre die Sicherstellung kostendeckender Beiträge für ALG-II-Beziehende

…“

Pressemitteilung vom 29.06.2022


 (ver.di kritisiert Pläne zur Deckung der GKV-Defizite – Werneke: „Vorschläge nicht geeignet“), siehe dazu (

Pflegebudget im gesonderten Dossier

):


[„GKV-Kaputtspargesetz“] Klinikbeschäftigte wehren sich gegen Kürzungsfolgen und zeigen ihre Solidarität mit den Streikenden an der Charité


„

Die Beschäftigten der Krankenhäuser setzen sich gegen die Folgen der Reform der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung zur Wehr. Das bekräftigten heute mehr als 200 Mitglieder betrieblicher Interessenvertretungen aus über 100 Krankenhäusern unterschiedlicher Trägerschaft bei einer von ver.di organisierten Tagung in Berlin. In einer Resolution kritisierten sie, wegen des „GKV-Kaputtspargesetzes“ stehe zu befürchten, „dass noch mehr Fachabteilungen und Kliniken geschlossen, Arbeitsplätze und Tarifverträge infrage gestellt werden“. Dagegen kündigten die Teilnehmenden weiteren Widerstand an und zeigten zugleich ihre Solidarität mit den Streikenden des Berliner Uniklinikums Charité, die die Tagung mit einer Delegation besuchten

…“

ver.di-Pressemitteilung vom 19.11.2026


 zur verabschiedeten

Resolution

 


Siehe zum aktuellen Hintergrund das Dossier:

(Warn)Streik des Pflegepersonals für Entlastung durch tarifliche Personalbemessung an der Charité


Gesundheitskürzungen 2027: Weiter Beiträge zahlen – aber wer behandelt dich noch?


„


Dein Arzt hört auf. Du ziehst um. Oder du brauchst zum ersten Mal einen Facharzt. Dann beginnt das Telefonieren. Die Frage für 2027 lautet: Was passiert, wenn immer mehr Praxen auf dieselbe Idee kommen – weniger zusätzliche Termine, weniger neue Patienten?


Auf deiner Gesundheitskarte steht nicht, wie lange du auf Hilfe warten kannst. Dein Rücken fragt nicht nach dem nächsten Quartal. (…) Die Kassenärztliche Bundesvereinigung rechnet für 2027 mit rund drei Milliarden Euro Einsparungen im ambulanten Bereich. Sie warnt vor weniger Terminen und größeren Schwierigkeiten, einen neuen Arzt oder Psychotherapeuten zu finden. Das ist die Warnung der ärztlichen Interessenvertretung. Keine erfundene Schreckensgeschichte. (…) Wie handfest das wird, zeigt Schleswig-Holstein. Die dortige Kassenärztliche Vereinigung nennt ausdrücklich Schmerztherapie, internistische Rheumatologie und Schlaflabor: Bislang frei vergütete Leistungen dieser Bereiche können künftig nicht mehr unbegrenzt zum vollen Preis bezahlt werden. Nach den veröffentlichten Eckpunkten wird oberhalb bestimmter Praxisvolumina nur noch anteilig vergütet. (…) Auch bisher zusätzlich vergütete Früherkennungs- und Gesundheitsuntersuchungen werden budgetiert. Die KV Nordrhein nennt zudem den Medikationsplan. Die Leistungen bleiben Kassenleistungen; die Finanzierung zusätzlicher Leistungen wird begrenzt. (…) Die Zuzahlungsbeträge und entsprechenden Grenzen werden um 50 Prozent angehoben. Die jährlichen einkommensbezogenen Belastungsgrenzen bleiben: grundsätzlich zwei Prozent, bei entsprechend anerkannten chronisch Kranken ein Prozent. Eine Begrenzung schützt. Sie macht die vorher fälligen Beträge trotzdem nicht unsichtbar. (…) Das Ministerium will mit dem Paket weitere Beitragserhöhungen vermeiden. Die politische Rechnung muss sich aber auch daran messen lassen, was Menschen zusätzlich bezahlen und wie zuverlässig sie Versorgung bekommen. Ein stabilisierter Beitrag allein behandelt niemanden. (…) Ob du selbst krank bist, deinen Partner unterstützt oder deine Eltern begleitest: Begrenzte Versorgung verschwindet nicht einfach aus der Welt. Jemand muss die Suche, die Wege und die Wartezeit übernehmen. Die entscheidende Frage lautet deshalb: Wer trägt die Folgen, wenn eine Einsparung in der Praxis zum zusätzlichen Aufwand am Küchentisch wird? (…) …

title: Cîgirê Şaredarê Eyûpsûltanê Çagdaş Can Elmali hat girtin
content:
Alîkarê Şaredarê Eyûpsûltanê Çagdaş Can Elmali ku di çarçoveya lêpirsîna Serdozgeriya Enqereyê ya li dijî Şaredariya Eyûpsûltanê de di 19ê Mijdarê de hatibû desteserkirin, hat girtin.


Di çarçoveya lêpirsînê de Şaredar Mithat Bulent Ozmen jî di nav de 13 kes hatibûn girtin û 4 kes jî bi şertê kontrola edlî hatibûn berdan.


Li dijî Şaredariya Eyupsultanê operasyon pêk hat: Saredar jî di nav de 28 kes hatin desteserkirin


2 Cotmeh 2026


Di heman dosyayê de Alîkarê Şaredarê Eyûpsûltanê Çağdaş Can Elmalı jî duh hatibû desteserkirin.


Biryara girtina Elmal,yê desteserkirî hat dayîn.


Çi bûbû?

Di çarçoveya lêpirsînê de gumanbar bi "endamtiya rêxistina sûc", "bertîlgirtin", "bertîldan" û "gendeltiya di îhaleyê de" hatibûn tohmetbarkirin.

title: (Warn)Streik des Pflegepersonals für Entlastung durch tarifliche Personalbemessung an der Charité
content:
Dossier


Seit zwei Jahren verhandelt ver.di mit dem Vorstand der Charité über Mindestbesetzungsregelung und Maßnahmen zum Gesundheitsschutz für alle Beschäftigten an der Charité. Der Vorstand hatte zuletzt Regelungen für die Intensivstationen und eine Aufstockung der sog. „Nachtdienstverbünde“ angeboten. Dies brächte eine Verbesserung für ca. 700 der über 13.000 Beschäftigten. Der Charité-Vorstand bleibt auch nach zwei Jahren Verhandlungen ein Angebot schuldig, mit dem eine Verbesserung der Arbeitsbedingungen für alle Beschäftigten erreicht werden kann. Auch beim „Konsequenzenmanagement“ (Entlastungsregelungen für den Fall, dass Personalvorgaben nicht eingehalten werden können) macht die Charité kein belastbares Angebot. Nach der massiven Beteiligung am Warnstreik vom 27.-28. April 2015 sorgt das Verhalten der Geschäftsführung für großes Unverständnis unter den Beschäftigten der Charité. Die ver.di-Tarifkommission sieht vor diesem Hintergrund in dem Arbeitgeberangebot keine Basis für weitere Verhandlungen… Siehe zu Hintergründen, Aktionen, Solierklärungen und Aufrufen

die ver.di-Aktionsseite


. Solidaritätserklärungen willkommen! Bitte sendet diese an:

info@mehr-krankenhauspersonal.de.

Siehe dazu neu:


Streikankündigung für nächste Woche versendet und „auch im neuen Jahr streikbereit für einen guten TVE“: Die Verhandlungen an der Charité am 20.11. entscheiden


Verhandlungen an der Charité gehen in entscheidende Phase – Charité-Vorstand kann Streik nächste Woche abwenden


„… „

Wir bekommen in manchen Bereichen positive Signale und Teilergebnisse, zum Beispiel bei der Radiologie und der Dialyse. Aber es sind auch noch sehr viele Punkte offen. Wir werden keinen Tarifvertrag akzeptieren, der Kolleg:innen ausschließt oder eine unzureichende Personalausstattung regelt. Die Arbeitgeberin will zum Teil Besetzungen unterhalb oder auf dem Niveau der von ihr gerichtlich geforderten Notdienste tarifieren. Dafür haben wir kein Verständnis. Knackpunkt bleiben Bereiche wie OP/Anästhesie, Notaufnahmen, Intensivstationen, Therapeut:innen, Ausbildung sowie kleinere Bereiche, und vor allem ein wirksamer Belastungsausgleich.“ sagt Gisela Neunhöffer, Verhandlungsführerin bei ver.di. (…) „Wenn wir so unverzichtbar sind, dass wir selbst im Streik in manchen Bereichen fast vollzählig zur Arbeit müssen und unser Grundrecht eingeschränkt wird, muss eine gute Personalausstattung auch wirklich abgesichert sein. Wir werden keinen Papiertiger abschließen. Wenn es sein muss, sind wir auch im neuen Jahr streikbereit für einen guten TVE“ so Laura Müller-Nakamoto, OP-Pflegerin und Teamdelegierte.


Für nächste Woche hat die Gewerkschaft vorsorglich eine Streikankündigung an die Arbeitgeberin versendet, um die entsprechenden Vorbereitungen zu ermöglichen. Über die Durchführung des Streiks werde man angesichts des Verhandlungsstandes am Freitagabend entscheiden

.“

Pressemitteilung vom 19.11.2026 beim ver.di-Landesbezirk Berlin-Brandenburg

author: Marina Amaral
title: Os Guajajara e os Awá Guajá: gestos de amor em meio à violência no território
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a Newsletter da Pública, enviada sempre às sextas-feiras, 8h. Para receber as próximas edições,

inscreva-se aqui

.


“A gente vive com nossos irmãozinhos Awa há muito tempo, sente a presença deles, vê as coisinhas deles, mas deixa eles quieto. Às vezes a gente tem que chamar a atenção dos mais novos, né? Um guerreiro que não têm um facão pra fazer arco bom, pega as flechas boas deles, não sabe fazer rede confortável pra dormir, pega as redes que eles fazem de embira de tucum. Malina as coisas deles quando eles não estão, aí eles não gostam, né? Eles sabem porque, quando eles saem, os pássaros que eles criam avisam pra eles. Começa a dar sinal e eles já sabem que tem pessoa estranha no entorno deles. Eles são como os nossos antigos, vivem só da natureza”.


A declaração emocionada de Olímpio Guajajara, líder dos Guardiões da Floresta da TI Araribóia, no Maranhão, feita durante uma entrevista em 2023, me pegou de jeito. Eu estava na TI, fazendo uma

reportagem

 sobre a violência e a impunidade no território invadido por madeireiros, criadores de gado, traficantes, e até pelos municípios vizinhos, que também se expandiram na área de 413 mil hectares da TI, demarcada em 1982, onde vivem mais de 10 mil indígenas, a maioria deles da etnia Guajajara.

A ternura na fala do guerreiro, acostumado a enfrentar invasores e sofrer com a morte de companheiros, me comoveu. 


Os Guajajara são uma das etnias indígenas com contato mais antigo com os brancos – documentado desde o século 17- e com uma história de luta intensa, até pela proximidade com os não indígenas, que vivem no entorno ou mesmo dentro do próprio território através de casamentos e acordos. Resistiram, mantiveram os costumes e a língua do povo, mas continuam a enfrentar a violência contínua no território, quase sozinhos, uma vez que as operações policiais não dão conta de defendê-los de forma permanente. 


Para se proteger – e também aos “irmãozinhos” Awá Guajá, indígenas isolados há mais de 40 anos avistados na TI Arariboia – os Guajajara criaram um grupo de Guardiões, que faz rondas, localiza invasores e, em alguns casos, detém os criminosos ou seus pertences até a chegada da polícia. Desde 2012, seis guardiões foram assassinados, e mais de uma dezena de líderes foram mortos até o ano passado – quando 8 indígenas Guajajara foram mortos de acordo com o relatório do Cimi. Os crimes ficam impunes.

 Mesmo quando os inquéritos se tornam processos, principalmente em casos com repercussão na imprensa, as condenações são raras – a maioria dos homicídios é atribuída a “brigas” pela polícia civil, o que mascara a relação com o território, o que os tornaria crimes federais e, portanto, a cargo da PF.


Os Awá Guajá se isolaram voluntariamente em áreas de floresta preservada da TI, cada vez menores por causa do desmatamento provocado pelos invasores. A proteção do território e o combate ao desmatamento feito pelos Guardiões têm sido fundamentais para a sobrevivência dos isolados

, como reconhecem a Funai e ONGs, que contribuem para financiar o grupo, que cuida do território sem interferir em seus costumes – há inclusive uma TI Awá Guajá, compartilhada com outras etnias, mas os isolados preferem as matas da Araribóia. 


Por isso, Olímpio Guajajara viu a

presença

 de cerca de 15 isolados em uma das aldeias da TI como sinal de alarme. Embora avistassem pequenos grupos ali e aqui, e calculassem entre 40 e 60 pessoas da etnia no território, o fato de eles se mostrarem tão perto e voluntariamente, rompendo a reclusão histórica, alarmou os guardiões: que ameaças os isolados estariam sofrendo para chegar tão perto dos Guajajara, a ponto de causarem preocupação no governo federal, procuradores, antropólogos e os próprios indígenas com a possibilidade de se

contaminarem

 pela transmissão de doenças?


Os Guajajara também enfrentaram uma grave crise durante a pandemia de Covid, tanto que foram incluídos na ADPF 709, que resultou na exigência do STF da desintrusão (retirada de não indígenas) de sete TIs, entre elas a Araribóia, cumprida no primeiro semestre de 2025. Mas como mostram o relatório do CIMI e a aparição dos “irmãozinhos” isolados, o território continua longe de ser seguro para os indígenas. O que só aumenta a preocupação com os Awá, uma das etnias mais

ameaçadas

 do planeta. 


Além do Ministério Público, que declarou estar monitorando a atuação das autoridades no caso, a Funai lançou uma …

title: Ji Egîtîm Senê banga 20ê Mijdarê: Ji bo her zarokekî mafê perwerdehiya bi zimanê dayîkê
content:
Sendîkaya Kedkarên Perwerde û Zanistê (Egîtîm Sen), di daxuyaniya xwe ya bi boneya 20ê Mijdarê Roja Mafên Zarokan a Cîhanî de diyar kir ku li Tirkiyeyê mafên jiyan, perwerde, tenduristî û parastina civakî yên zarokan tên binpêkirin.


Sendîkayê aşkere kir ku karkeriya zarokan bi rêya Navendên Perwerdehiya Pîşeyî (MESEM) tê berbelavkirin û da zanîn ku li gorî daneyên Wezareta Perwerdehiya Neteweyî (MEB), 37 zarokên ku di vê çarçoveyê de dixebitîn jiyana xwe ji dest dane.


Rêxistina Parastina Zarokan: 589 milyon zarok li herêmên şer dijîn


20 Mijdar 2026


Egîtîm Senê xwest ku zarok ji tundkarî, îstîsmar û kedxwariyê bên parastin, li dibistanan xwarina bêpere bê dayîn û mafê perwerdehiya bi zimanê dayîkê bê misogerkirin.


"Karkeriya zarokan di bin navê perwerdehiya pîşeyî de tê rewakirin"


Sendîkayê diyar kir ku MESEM û dibistanên navîn ên pîşeyî zarokan ber bi wê ve dibin ku piraniya hefteyê bi mûçeyên kêm bixebitin û teqez kir ku mafê perwerdehiyê tê paşguhkirin.


Egîtîm Senê bal kişand ser wê yekê ku zarokên di çarçoveya MESEMê de di karên bêkontrol û metirsîdar de tên xebitandin û da zanîn ku li gorî daneyên MEBê 37 zarokan dema dixebitîn jiyana xwe ji dest dane û bi sedan zarok jî rastî qezayên kar hatine. Sendîkayê destnîşan kir ku ji ber ku hemû qeza nayên tomarkirin, dane tabloya rastîn nîşan nadin.


Yekem rêzefîlma anîmasyonî ya kurdî: "Pirsên Azad" wê di Zarok TVyê de dest pê bike


14 Cotmeh 2026


Egîtîm Senê diyar kir ku daneyên Meclisa Tenduristiya Karkeran û Ewlehiya Karî (İSİG) jî zêdebûna kuştinên zarokan ên li kar radixin pêş çavan û bang kir: "Divê demildest dev ji vê sepanê bê berdan ku tê wateya rewakirina karkeriya zarokan bi destê dewletê."


Daxwaza xwarina bêpere li dibistanan


Egîtîm Senê destnîşan kir ku hejariya zêde û buhayên bilind ên xwarinê rê li ber têrxwarina zarokan digirin û teqez kir ku xwarina bitendurist ne alîkariyeke civakî ye, mafekî bingehîn e ku dewlet bi dabînkirina wê berpirsyar e.


Sendîkayê bal kişand ser wê yekê ku kêmxwarinî dikare bibe sedema pirsgirêkên pêşketina fîzîkî û derûnî, têlçûna balê û zehmetiyên fêrbûnê ya zarokan. Her weha xwest ku ji bo pêkanîna wekheviya di perwerdehiyê de li dibistanan xwarineke tendurist a bêpere û ava paqij bên dayîn.


FİSA: Di sê mehan de 239 zarok mirine

Bal kişand ser mafê perwerdehiya bi zimanê dayîkê


Egîtîm Senê anî ziman ku şerhên Tirkiyeyê yên li ser xalên 17, 29 û 30î yên Peymana Mafên Zarokan a Neteweyên Yekbûyî, mafên perwerdehî û nasnameya çandî yên zarokên ku xwedî zimanên dayîkê yên cuda ne sînordar dikin.

I feel like not enough people realize that people under enormous strain act really really fucking Weird

things humans are known to do when stressed:

-hallucinate

-cry over what seems to be small things

-become furiously angry over what seems to be small things

-hit a self destruct button over and over again

-lose all sense of reality

-becoming straight up unable to communicate

-view every situation as life or death

-experience delusions/become vulnerable to irrational worldviews

-perceive hostility where none exists

-become extremely nauseous and/or throw up

-stop engaging in sleeping/eating/basic hygiene

-stop processing sensory input

-process way too much sensory input all at once

-lash out at others/themselves

-and more!

being able to recognize when a human (ie. you or another person) is so stressed out they cannot think clearly is VERY important for conflict resolution and diffusing emotional crisis. highly recommend trying to train yourself at being able to recognize that state of panic- there is a point in which logic and rationality is useless and you have to address the underlying emotional issue first. knowing that saves everyone a lot of pain and struggle.

It’s also good to understand that all of these reactions are USEFUL. They’re all part of our survival system, telling us we need to be able to fight better, flight better, freeze better, fawn better.

-hallucinate > some experiences are too difficult for our brain to process all at once. To avoid complete overwhelm, the mind seeks distraction and escape or translates invisible stress into visble metaphors.

-cry over what seems to be small things > Crying releases tension. Our body needs it. If we don’t cry over the Big Stress, we will cry over the small things to regulate.

-become furiously angry over what seems to be small things > Rage also releases tension. Our body needs it. If we don’t rage over the Big Stress, we will rage over the small things to regulate.

-hit a self destruct button over and over again > Our survival instinct does not accept powerlessness. When we lose all sense of control over reality, we do whatever makes us feel in control again. If the only control we can have is self-destructive, that is the control we will reach for.

-lose all sense of reality > again, some experiences are too difficult for our brain to process all at once. To avoid complete overwhelm, the mind seeks distraction and escape or translates invisible stress into visible metaphors.

-becoming straight up unable to communicate > Too much stress is really bad for us, not just mentally but also for our heart, our blood pressure, our digestion, etc. Our biology has a fail safe system: if the stress is too much, shut parts of the brain down. Block the input until the stress is lowered, so that at least we don’t overload complete.y

-view every situation as life or death > When we go into survival mode, our body is pumped full of stress hormones and they linger (both because your body needs time to process them and because we’ve evolved around predators that might linger in an area, so we’ve evolved to stay on guard long after a danger). Our body keeps us in survival mode - ready to fight/flight/freeze/fawn to keep us alive.

-experience delusions/become vulnerable to irrational worldviews > again, some experiences are too difficult for our brain to process all at once. To avoid complete overwhelm, the mind seeks distraction and escape or translates invisible stress into visble metaphors.

-perceive hostility where none exists > again, when we go into survival more we stay there a while - ready to fight/flight/freeze/fawn to keep us alive.

-become extremely nauseous and/or throw up > when we go into survival mode, our body puts all its energy into the organs that we need to fight/flight/freeze/fawn. Digestion is suppressed. It can wait. (This is also why stress constipation is a thing). If what’s currently in the stomach can not stay there and wait, best to get rid of it so the body doesn’t waste vital energy on digestion.

-stop engaging in sleeping/eating/basic hygiene > Again, when we go into survival mode, our body is pumped full of stress hormones and they linger. They keep us awake. They suppress feelings of hunger, thirst etc. to make us better survivors in the moment of danger.

-stop processing sensory input > again,  if the stress is too much, our system shuts parts of the brain …

author: Authors and Editor
title: Seeds and Seedbeds: Two Venezuelan Initiatives for Science for Life
content:
A group of farmers runs a potato-seed laboratory in Mucuchíes, in the Venezuelan state of Mérida, 3,600 metres above sea level. The Ministry of Science and Technology (Mincyt) describes this laboratory, the Biotechnology Centre for Training in Agamic Seed Production (Cebisa), as the most advanced of its kind in the country. In April 2025, the government formally handed over expanded training facilities to Cebisa, which has operated since 2009.

[1]


A few weeks later, on 2 May, more than 250 children and young people from ten municipalities in Zulia presented 100 robotics projects designed to solve problems in their local communities.

[2]


Initiatives of this kind exist in other Global South countries. What sets these apart is their context: the Venezuelan state has incorporated them into a national project, and that project stems from a question posed by Hugo Chávez: what is the purpose of each technology?

[3]


For Chávez, that question could not be answered within the confines of laboratories. A national development project could not succeed, he argued, unless it conceived, designed, and built its own scientific and technological approach. In Venezuela, this project took on institutional form in 1999, when Chávez came to power. The Scientific-Peasant Alliance and the National Scientific Seedbeds Programme (Semilleros) are two of its manifestations: one sows seeds, the other sows vocations. By bringing farmers and young people into scientific work, these initiatives also raise another question: who is recognised as a producer of knowledge, and who decides?


What Kind of Science? For What Purpose, and Who Produces It?


In June 2007, speaking to a group of grassroots inventors, Hugo Chávez acknowledged that Venezuela needed technological mastery for reasons of sovereignty and security. However, recalling the Argentine scientist Oscar Varsavsky, he added that the primary problem was not ‘know-how’ but ‘know-what’. Technology, he argued, should be neither an end in itself nor a commodity, but a means to meet needs. He concluded: ‘we have an obligation to understand the purpose of every technology’.

[4]


Varsavsky (1920–1976) devoted much of his work to a question that was uncomfortable for his profession: who decides what is researched and for what purpose? In

Science, Politics and Scientism

, he argued that the science of his time was not neutral but adapted to the social system that funded and organised it. He described ‘scientism’ as the attitude of researchers who adapted to this scientific market, ceased to concern themselves with the social significance of their work, and adopted the norms and values of the major international centres. For him, the decisive task was to set the research topics, assign priorities, and organise the work around the needs of social change.

[5]


In

Towards a National Science Policy

 (1972), he extended the argument to the realm of public policy. If a country framed its scientific development as ‘closing the gap’ with advanced nations, he warned, it effectively smuggled in the essence of their way of life. Every societal project, by contrast, required its own scientific and technological approach.

[6]


What Varsavsky termed ‘scientism’ has a longer history. Modern science took shape alongside capitalism and Europe’s colonial expansion from the 16th century onwards, with methods, values, and perspectives that this expansion imposed on the world as universal. It rested on a division between two planes of knowledge: that which distinguishes the true from the false, and that which distinguishes right from wrong. The former was taken to be objective knowledge and became science. The latter was assigned to the subjective realm of ethics.


Modern science was thus constructed in isolation from ethics. It declared itself objective and neutral, and proclaimed itself the only valid form of knowledge. It has undoubtedly brought great advances for humanity. Yet, alongside unprecedented scientific and technological development, humanity’s major problems – inequality, poverty, hunger, disease, and environmental crisis – persist, and the way science is put to use has helped deepen some of them.


This contradiction is rooted in the economic and political relations within which science develops. Under capitalism, the accumulation of capital shapes research priorities, funding, the ownership of results, and the direction of innovation. Knowledge becomes a commodity, produced for …
