title: Yazidi women forced to relive trauma to access their rights
content:
Years have passed since the genocide that remains etched in the memory of the Kurdish people. Yet for Yazidi (Êzîdî) women, the darkness that began on 3 August 2014 has not ended. Many of the women abducted from Shengal are still missing, while their families continue to wait for news of their whereabouts and what happened to them. Some hope for a mass grave to be opened, others await DNA test results, while others still hope that a loved one who has not returned home for years will one day come back.


Massacres, abductions and captivity


ISIS carried out a systematic genocide against the Yazidi community when it attacked Shengal on 3 August 2014. Men and boys were separated from their families and massacred, while women and girls were abducted, sold in slave markets, forced into marriage and subjected to rape. Women's bodies became a target of ISIS's campaign to destroy Yazidi identity and the community's very existence.


2,474 women still missing


During the genocide, 6,417 Yazidi women were abducted. Of these, 3,647 regained their freedom, while the fate of 2,474 remains unknown. Among those registered as missing, 269 were confirmed dead, and their remains were returned to their families. The abducted women were first taken to Mosul, then to Tal Afar, Raqqa, Deir ez-Zor and Baghouz. Women and children were moved between different cities, separated from one another and cut off from their families.


For women, captivity was not limited to a single act of abduction. Some were transferred between captors, sold to different individuals and forcibly displaced within ISIS-controlled territories, leaving their whereabouts unknown for years. Some women managed to escape, while others reached different countries. The fate of thousands remains uncertain.


Those who sought refuge in Europe


For Yazidi women who escaped ISIS captivity, the struggle to rebuild their lives extended far beyond Shengal. Some survivors were forced to settle in different countries to access medical treatment, rehabilitation and safe living conditions.


Following the genocide, Germany launched a special humanitarian resettlement programme for Yazidi women and children. Under the programme implemented by the state of Baden-Württemberg in 2015 and 2016, approximately 1,100 women and children, the vast majority of them Yazidis, were brought to Germany. They were provided with accommodation, healthcare, psychological support and educational opportunities. Canada also implemented admission and family reunification programmes for ISIS survivors, including Yazidi women and children. In 2023, the Canadian government announced that it had enabled more than 1,400 survivors to build new lives in the country.


However, establishing a safe life in another country did not erase the absence of missing loved ones or the pain of families torn apart. Some women who settled in Europe are still trying to discover the fate of their relatives in Iraq, while survivors forced to live far from their homeland have encountered new obstacles in seeking their rights. The rupture caused by the genocide has therefore continued to shape women's lives not only in Shengal but also in the countries where they have been forced to settle.


The path to freedom in Rojava


Following the liberation of Shengal in November 2015, Rojava played an important role in reuniting women and children rescued from ISIS with their families. Those freed through the efforts of the Women's Protection Units (YPJ) and the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) were reunited with their families through the work of the Yazidi Women's Freedom Movement (TAJÊ) and the Shengal Autonomous Administration.


Women rebuilt their lives


The struggle of Yazidi women did not end with their liberation from captivity. Following the genocide, women began organising to prevent similar attacks and gain control over their own lives. Women established self-defence forces within the Shengal Women's Units (Yekîneyên Jinên Şengalê, YJŞ), playing a major role in the defence and liberation of Shengal. The women's organising efforts that began in 2015 gained an institutional structure in September 2016 with the establishment of TAJÊ.


This process also brought significant changes to women's position in society. Previously largely confined to family and traditional social roles, women began taking responsibility not only for self-defence but also in education, politics, diplomacy and community organising. Through women's …

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish young man faces trial in Iran on charges carrying death penalty
content:
A young Kurdish man, Mehdî Roşanî, who was detained and arrested following protests held in the city of Melîkşah (Malekshah), in Iran’s Îlam province, between December 2025 and January 2026, appeared before a court in Îlam on 18 November. He is facing several charges, including “enmity against God” and “spreading corruption on earth.”


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) reported that Roşanî and his defence lawyers attended the hearing before the First Branch of the Revolutionary Court in Îlam. Roşanî denied all the charges against him.


Roşanî was first arrested on 16 January during protests in his hometown of Melîkşah. After spending approximately three months in prison, he was released on bail. The Revolutionary Court in Îlam subsequently sentenced him to three years in prison, a sentence that was later reduced to nine months.


Roşanî was arrested again by regime forces on 18 July and transferred to Îlam Central Prison.


Following his re-arrest, the Sixth Branch of the Investigation Department of the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office in Îlam opened a new case against him. The charges of “enmity against God” and “spreading corruption on earth” brought against Roşanî are offences under Iranian law that can carry the death penalty.

author: Unknown
title: DFG pays tribute to newspaper distributors murdered in the 1990s
content:
In a written statement, the Dicle Fırat Journalists Association (DFG) paid tribute to newspaper distributors who were murdered while taking part in the struggle for a free press during the 1990s. The statement recalled that Adil Başkan was murdered in Nusaybin on 9 November 1993; Yalçın Yaşa in Amed on 10 November 1993; Kadir Ipeksürer in Riha (Urfa) on 19 November 1993; Halil Adanır in Êlih (Batman) on 21 November 1992; Adnan Işık in Wan (Van) on 27 November 1993; and Nihat Yakut in Amed on 27 November 1998.


The statement noted that, despite the harsh conditions, threats and pressure of the time, the newspaper distributors struggled to deliver newspapers to the public. It said: “Risking their lives to bring the truth to the public under the most difficult conditions of the time, newspaper distributors stood on the front lines of the struggle for a free press.”


Emphasising that the distributors carried not only newspapers but also the public’s right to access information and the truth, the statement noted that they were known as Apê Musa’s “Little Generals”. It added that the struggle of the 17 newspaper distributors who were murdered, from Halil Adanır to Kadri Bağdu, remains an unforgettable part of the history of the free press.


The DFG concluded its statement with the following words: “We commemorate with respect and longing all newspaper distributors who lost their lives bringing the truth to the public. We once again reaffirm our commitment to keeping their memories alive and continuing the struggle for a free press.”

author: Unknown
title: Horuş: COP31's focus on implementation contradicts reality
content:
Mehmet Horuş, a lawyer specialising in environmental litigation, said that the emphasis on "implementation" at the 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), held in Antalya, was inconsistent with policies on the ground. He drew attention to continued reliance on coal, investments in nuclear energy and projects causing ecological destruction. Citing the urgent expropriation decision in Akbelen, the downgrading of Lake Eğirdir's protected status and nuclear cooperation agreements, Horuş said, "What we understand by 'implementation' is continued reliance on coal, nuclear opportunism and the pursuit of ecocidal projects."


Mehmet Horuş, a volunteer with the Climate Justice Coalition who has represented environmental cases concerning the Sinop Nuclear Power Plant and Kanal Istanbul projects, answered ANF's questions at the Peoples' Climate Summit in Antalya.


What has changed in environmental litigation since the struggle launched by Bergama villagers against cyanide-based gold mining in the 1990s? How are favourable court rulings implemented on the ground?


The Bergama struggle was one of the turning points for Turkey's ecological movement. It marked a stage at which the ecological struggle became a people's movement. Following the Bergama villagers, local resistance spread across the country through struggles against hydroelectric power plants (HPPs) in the Black Sea region. We can say that the Bergama villagers paved the way for the ecological struggle to become a mass movement.


The rulings issued in the Bergama case remain among the most important decisions in Turkish environmental law. The Council of State's legal precedent concerning cyanide-based gold mining remains a highly progressive ruling even today. However, the failure to implement court decisions and the efforts to circumvent them also turned the Bergama struggle into a symbol of a process in which the social state governed by the rule of law abandoned the villagers.


'The law has been placed at the service of corporations'


Since then, neoliberal policies have increasingly placed the law at the service of corporations and the market rather than the public interest. Legal obstacles facing companies, or the provisions on which our legal victories were based, have been amended in favour of corporations. Even attempts to change legislation concerning olive cultivation demonstrate how the law has been reshaped to benefit companies.


Changes made in favour of corporations, particularly in the mining sector, have deprived the ecological struggle of legal safeguards. This has pushed local movements and platforms towards a struggle that draws strength not only from legal proceedings inside courtrooms but also from society, the streets and collective resistance.


In ecological struggles, the law is no longer confined to courtrooms. It has become a practice of creating law. A dynamic has emerged in which people take action, seek to transform the law through their actions and create legal norms themselves. For this reason, we cannot describe what is happening as a conventional legal struggle.


The Italian thinker and legal scholar Giorgio Agamben uses the concept of the "state of exception", sometimes translated into Turkish as a "state of emergency", to describe situations in which states create exceptional circumstances that allow them to violate their own laws. Can we speak of a similar situation in the struggle for ecology and nature?


Yes. This situation also reminds me of Carl Schmitt's theory. We are living under a permanent state of exception in Turkey. Filing an environmental lawsuit is almost ceasing to be an effective legal remedy. Nevertheless, we have no intention of abandoning the legal struggle.


The reason is the erosion of law as a universal standard of justice. Today's summit also reveals the global dimension of the local problem we have been discussing through Bergama. Just as we question the law in Bergama, the United Nations' (UN) failure to implement its own regulations concerning biodiversity, climate change and desertification points to a similar problem on a global scale. The UN has moved away from its role as an institution capable of delivering genuine justice.


We are fighting for climate justice against global lawlessness. Peoples are trying to establish their own norms, struggles and moral, political and legal standards. Whether we call it capitalism …

author: anred
title: Salud dolarizada y sin genéricos: la ofensiva del Gobierno para entregar el control de los medicamentos a las corporaciones extranjeras
content:
Reunión plenaria de las comisiones de Relaciones Exteriores y Culto y de Industria y Comercio ,el 15 de octubre de 2026, en el salón Illia del Senado de la Nación, en Buenos Aires; Argentina. Fotos: Celeste Salguero/ Comunicación Senado.-


A través de la doble pinza del bilateral Acuerdo sobre Comercio e Inversiones Recíprocos (ARTI) y la reciente aprobación del Tratado de Cooperación en materia de Patentes (PCT) en el Senado, el Gobierno nacional avanza en el desmantelamiento de los mecanismos legales e institucionales que habilitan fabricar genéricos, lo que permite bajar precios. Detrás de la desregulación aparecen los intereses financieros del ministro Federico Sturzenegger en BlackRock y una hoja de ruta escrita a medida de las corporaciones extranjeras.

Por Fundación GEP (Grupo Efecto Positivo).


Mientras la atención pública se concentra en los ajustes presupuestarios cotidianos, en los despachos del Poder Ejecutivo y en los pasillos del Congreso avanza una reforma silenciosa pero devastadora para el derecho a la salud. Bajo el discurso de la «modernización» y la apertura comercial, el Gobierno nacional ejecuta una hoja de ruta diseñada para subordinar la política sanitaria argentina a las exigencias de los Estados Unidos y garantizar ganancias extraordinarias a las grandes farmacéuticas transnacionales. 


El mecanismo tiene dos engranajes que operan en simultáneo: por un lado, la negociación del acuerdo bilateral ARTI con Washington; por el otro, la reciente aprobación en el Senado de la adhesión de la Argentina al Tratado de Cooperación en materia de Patentes (PCT), que ya contaba con media sanción de Diputados. Con la sanción de este esquema, el país pierde herramientas legales y científicas fundamentales que durante más de una década frenaron los monopolios abusivos y permitieron garantizar tratamientos vitales a una fracción de su costo internacional. 


ARTI: una hoja de ruta escrita en Washington


El acuerdo ARTI —cuyo texto completo ni siquiera ha sido puesto a disposición de la ciudadanía en español— funciona como el marco político donde se inscriben todas las concesiones exigidas por la industria farmacéutica estadounidense. No se trata de un simple tratado comercial, sino de un programa de desmantelamiento regulatorio con consecuencias directas sobre el cuerpo y el bolsillo de la población y los presupuestos de todos los subsistemas de salud. 


Uno de los primeros golpes contra nuestro sistema sanitario fue la derogación de las Guías de Patentabilidad de 2012 mediante la Resolución Conjunta 1/2026. Estas normas funcionaban como un verdadero escudo contra el

evergreening

, una maniobra fraudulenta mediante la cual las corporaciones patentan modificaciones cosméticas sobre fármacos ya conocidos para estirar sus monopolios más allá de los 20 años. En esa misma dirección, el acuerdo ARTI institucionaliza la extensión del plazo de las patentes y obliga a reducir los tiempos de tramitación, apurando los expedientes para impedir que se realice un control técnico exhaustivo sobre la verdadera calidad inventiva. 


Reunión plenaria de las comisiones de Relaciones Exteriores y Culto y de Industria y Comercio ,el 15 de octubre de 2026, en el salón Illia del Senado de la Nación, en Buenos Aires; Argentina. Fotos: Celeste Salguero/ Comunicación Senado.-


A esto se suma el vaciamiento de la ANMAT, ya que el acuerdo exige homologar de manera automática las aprobaciones de la FDA estadounidense, anulando la capacidad de control y evaluación sanitaria propia de nuestros organismos científicos. 


Por otra parte, el tratado habilita la apropiación privada de información científica generada con la participación de las personas que han ofrecido sus cuerpos para el desarrollo de medicamentos, terapias, vacunas y otras tecnologías sanitarias al imponer cinco años de exclusividad sobre los datos de los ensayos clínicos. Esta cláusula impide que los laboratorios locales utilicen esa evidencia para registrar medicamentos genéricos, creando monopolios de hecho incluso cuando las patentes ya vencieron o nunca existieron. 


Como broche de este blindaje monopólico, incorpora medidas de frontera que otorgan poder de policía a la Aduana para retener y confiscar medicamentos genéricos ante la sola sospecha de infracción de patentes, sin necesidad de orden judicial. 


El PCT: una autopista para la avalancha de monopolios


En sintonía con los compromisos del ARTI, el oficialismo consumó en el Senado la sanción definitiva …

author: Natália Perez
title: As histórias que sempre estiveram por aqui – com Lilia Guerra
content:
“Eu pensei em escrever quando eu entrei em contato com informações de que a minha família não tinha a nossa origem.” É o que conta a romancista, contista e cronista, Lilia Guerra que acaba de lançar seu nono livro: “Velha Guarda”, pela editora Todavia.


Convidada do Pauta Pública desta semana, Lilia fala sobre seu o processo de escrita e sobre as atuais mudanças do mercado literário brasileiro. Um mapeamento de pesquisadores da Universidade de Brasília revelou que 97,5% dos romances publicados pelas maiores editoras do país entre 2005 e 2014 são de autores brancos. Nos últimos anos, porém, as histórias e produções de pessoas negras, que sempre existiram, vêm conquistando novos espaços de circulação e de reconhecimento.

author: kein vergeben. kein vergessen.
title: Möllner Rede im Exil – Screening in Berlin
content:
Samstag, 21.11.2026, 12:00–15:30 Uhr


Roter Laden, Weidenweg 17, 10249 Berlin-Friedrichshain


Am 23. November 1992 verübten Neonazis in Mölln rassistische Brandanschläge auf zwei Wohnhäuser. Drei Menschen wurden ermordet: Bahide Arslan, ihre Enkelin Yeliz Arslan und Ayşe Yılmaz. Zahlreiche weitere Menschen wurden verletzt und traumatisiert. Am selben Wochenende wurde in Berlin der Antifaschist Silvio Meier von Neonazis ermordet. Die Taten stehen für die beispiellose Explosion rechter Gewalt, die sich im nationalen Taumel nach der „Wiedervereinigung“ bahnbrach.


Die Stadt Mölln führte 2007 als Teil ihrer offiziellen Gedenkveranstaltung an den Brandanschlag die „Möllner Rede“ ein und wählte zunächst selbst den Redner aus. Für die folgenden Jahre setzte sich die Familie Arslan dafür ein, die Redner*innen selbst bestimmen zu dürfen. Doch 2012 kam es zum Konflikt: Nach der Rede der Holocaust-Überlebenden und Antifaschistin Beate Klarsfeld erklärte die Stadt die Rede für „zu politisch“ und strich sie für die kommenden Gedenken aus dem Programm. Seit 2013 entstand deshalb die „Möllner Rede im Exil“, durchgeführt in verschiedenen Städten außerhalb von Mölln, organisiert von den Angehörigen. Betroffene rechter Gewalt sind keine Statisten, sondern Protagonisten des Geschehens. Sie bestimmen selbst wie das Erinnern aussieht – und dazu gehört auch das Anklagen gesellschaftlicher Zustände, die erst die Basis für rechte Morde und Angriffe schaffen.


Die „Möllner Rede im Exil“ welche dieses Jahr in Münster stattfindet, gibt Überlebenden, Angehörigen und anderen Betroffenen Raum ihre Perspektiven einzubringen, Rassismus der Gegenwart zu benennen und ihm entgegenzutreten, anstatt nur zurückzublicken.


Am 23. November wird es einen Bus von Berlin nach Mölln geben, um vor Ort am Gedenken teilzunehmen und die Familien der Überlebenden zu unterstützen. Karten könnt ihr am 21.11 im Roten Laden oder ab sofort in der Baiz in Prenzlauer Berg für einen Solipreis erwerben.


Wir laden euch dazu ein, die Möllner Rede im Exil 2026 gemeinsam im Livestream zu verfolgen und im Anschluß miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen. Es gibt außerdem etwas zu Essen und warme und kalte Getränke. Im Anschluss fahren wir zusammen zum Silvio Meier-Gedenken.


Die Veranstaltung ist Teil der antifaschistischen Aktionswochen „Kein vergeben. Kein vergessen.“ Kommt zur Antifa-Demo am 20. November in Weißensee, am 21. November zum Silvio Meier-Gedenken in Friedrichshain und am 23. November zum Gedenken in Mölln.


Infos: www.kein-vergeben.org

author: Antifa Berlin
title: 15. November 2026 – Neonazi-Trauermarsch in Marzahn
content:
Für Sonntag, den 15. November 2026, hatten die Neonazis der „Deutschen Patrioten voran“ (DPV) in sozialen Medien und mit Plakaten zu einem Aufmarsch für die ermordete Jugendliche Lisa aus Marzahn aufgerufen. Auf den Plakaten, die verbreitet wurden, war kein Hinweis auf die veranstaltende Neonazistruktur zu finden. Lediglich das Motto „Härtere Strafen für Kinderschänder“ und der Hinweis auf schwarze Fahnen waren Indizien für die Urheber*innen.


Vor Ort am S-Bhf. Ahrensfelde fanden sich etwa 100 Anwohner*innen, darunter auch Kinder und Jugendliche, ein. Die Anmeldung, Ordner-Struktur sowie das mitgebrachte Fronttransparent wurden von DPV gestellt. Als Ordner*innen traten unter anderem Klaus Henning Gewald, Jason Hammerstein, Lucas Justin Glaser, Susen Gietz und weitere bekannte Neonazis (1-10) auf. Es war die erste DPV-Veranstaltung, an der Mandy Gietz seit ihrer Haftentlassung im März 2026 nicht teilnahm.


Nach einer Runde durch den Kiez gelangte der Aufmarsch zum Gedenkort, an dem sich Anwohner*innen und Antifaschist*innen zu einem stillen Gedenken versammelt hatten. Diese wurden von dem Neonazi-Streamer Stephan Böhlke belagert und beschimpft, bevor er von der Polizei abgeführt wurde. Die Polizei ließ dann die DPV-Neonazis und Teilnehmer*innen ihres Aufmarschs in kleinen Gruppen zum Gedenkort durch, wo sie die Anwesenden beleidigten.


Wir haben uns in diesem Beitrag darauf beschränkt, die organisierten Neonazis, die an dem Aufmarsch beteiligt waren, abzubilden. Die restlichen rund 90 Mitlaufenden überlegen es sich hoffentlich beim nächsten Mal gründlicher, ob sie in einem Neonazi-Aufmarsch mitlaufen.


Einen Überblick über die Mitglieder und Aktivitäten der DPV gibt es hier.


Alle Bilder sind öffentlichen Quellen entnommen. Bei Informationen zu den Teilnehmenden können diese an fightback[at]no-log.org gesendet werden.

author: taz
title: Rechter Kampfsport in Pankow – Boxtrainer wohl selbst Neonazi
content:
Der Vorsitzende des TSC Preußen 97 in Pankow hat beteuert, Neonazis aus dem Verein geworfen zu haben. Doch Fotos legen nahe, dass er selbst einer ist.


Seit Jahren halten Neonazis auf kommunalen Sportanlagen in Pankow Kampftrainings ab. Dabei steht ein Verein im Fokus: der TSC Preußen 97, in dessen Halle an der Rennbahnstraße immer wieder Übungen von einschlägig bekannten und gewaltbereiten Rechtsextremen dokumentiert wurden. Jedoch hat der Vorsitzende des Vereins, der Boxtrainer Manfred R., nach öffentlichem Druck bereits 2024 gegenüber Pankows Sportstadtrat Jörn Pasternack (CDU) versichert, die Neonazis aus dem Verein geschmissen zu haben.


Ein fragwürdiges Versprechen, wie sich jetzt erneut zeigt. Denn anscheinend finden nicht nur weiterhin Trainings mit Neonazis bei dem Verein statt, wie eine taz-Recherche im August offenlegte. Auch Manfred R. selbst ist oder war mutmaßlich selbst Teil der Neonaziszene. Das legen Fotos nahe, die der taz vorliegen.


Diese zeigen mutmaßlich Manfred R. im Jahr 2018 als Teilnehmer des Rudolf-Heß-Gedenkmarschs in Berlin. Der Mann trägt auf der Aufnahme eine sportliche Sonnenbrille, ein weißes Oberteil und eine schwarze Hose. Gleich neben ihm zu sehen ist ein Mann, der 2016 Kandidat der Neonazipartei NPD war – und früher auch an einem Training des TSC Preußen 97 teilgenommen hat. Um sie herum laufen weitere Teil­neh­me­r*in­nen der Neonazidemo, die meisten ähnlich gekleidet. Der Dresscode sollte die SA-Uniform nachahmen und zugleich das für Demonstrationen geltende Uniformverbot umgehen, indem Alltagskleidung angelegt wurde.


Der Gedenkmarsch zu Ehren des Hitler-Stellvertreters und Kriegsverbrechers Rudolf Heß hat sich seit dessen Tod im Jahr 1987 zu einem jährlichen Treffen von Neonazis aus ganz Deutschland, teilweise ganz Europa entwickelt. Auch NSU-Terroristen und Unterstützer nahmen in den 1990er Jahren an Heß-Märschen teil. Die Demonstration im August 2018, an der TSC-Trainer Manfred R. mutmaßlich teilgenommen hat, wurde vom ehemaligen Berliner NPD-Chef Sebastian Schmidtke organisiert. Aus dem gesamten Bundesgebiet reisten damals Teilnehmer aus der organisierten und gewaltbereiten Neonaziszene an.


Ob es sich auf dem Foto tatsächlich um ihn handelt, ließ R. offen. Auf mehrmalige Nachfrage der taz äußerte er sich nicht zu dem Foto und seiner mutmaßlichen Teilnahme an dem Aufmarsch.


Gezielte Kampftrainings statt zufälliger Bekanntschaft


Trotzdem: Die Fotos untermauern den Verdacht, dass die wiederholte Anwesenheit von Neonazis beim TSC Preußen 97 kein unglücklicher Zufall ist, wie Manfred R. glauben machen wollte. Der heute 77-Jährige hatte etwa gegenüber dem Tagesspiegel beteuert, von politischen Ansichten seiner Sparringspartner nichts zu wissen. Ihm gehe es um Sport, nicht um Politik. Auch scheint fraglich, dass ein Vereinschef, der selbst an Neonaziaufmärschen teilgenommen hat, effektiv gegen Neonazis in seinem Verein vorgehen kann. Im Gegenteil: Es scheint so, als würde Boxtrainer Manfred R. gezielt Kader der Berliner Neonaziszene im Kampfsport ausbilden.


Neuer Stoff also für die seit Jahren laufende Diskussion um den TSC und dessen Nutzung von Sportstätten des Bezirks Pankow. Vor allem der Umgang von Stadtrat Pasternack mit dem Verein wirft dabei Fragen auf. Wieso vertraut der CDU-Politiker dem Wort von Manfred R.?


Bezirk gibt sich machtlos


Auf Nachfrage der taz erklärt Pasternack jetzt, die mutmaßliche Teilnahme von Manfred R. am Heß-Marsch sei ihm nicht bekannt gewesen. Er nehme die Hinweise ernst. „Aus diesem Grund wurde die Senatsverwaltung für Inneres und Sport erneut darum gebeten, die Sportförderungswürdigkeit des Vereins unter Berücksichtigung der vorliegenden Hinweise zu überprüfen“, so Pasternack.


Denn bislang gilt der TSC Preußen 97 laut Innenverwaltung als förderungswürdig. Auf Grundlage dieser Einstufung darf der Verein die Räume des Bezirks Pankow umsonst nutzen und muss nur die Betriebskosten zahlen. Zwar endet der Nutzungsvertrag zwischen TSC und Bezirk für die Halle in Weißensee im März 2027. Eine Verlängerung ist jedoch nicht ausgeschlossen.


Denn solange keine anderen Sportvereine Interesse an der Halle in Weißensee anmelden, seien „die rechtlichen Möglichkeiten, dem Verein eine erneute Nutzung der Sportflächen zu verwehren, erheblich eingeschränkt“, sagt Pasternack – zumindest, sofern die Innenverwaltung die Förderungswürdigkeit weiterhin bestätigt.


Trotzdem wächst in Pankow der Druck auf das Bezirksamt, die Verträge nicht zu verlängern …

author: Unknown
title: Semaine du 9/11, dans les lycées de Lyon & environ
content:
Blocages, sabotages, fumi & mortiers


Les lycéen·nes continuent d'essayer de bloquer

 les établissements : notamment les lycées Doisneau, Brossolette (Villeurbanne), mais aussi Récamier, la Cité Scolaire Internationale (Lyon)…


Pour contourner l'omniprésence de la police devant les bahuts, les lycéen·nes mettent en œuvre de

nouvelles stratégies

 : des

blocages spontanés

 (récré de 10h, aprem…), des

fumigènes et tirs de mortiers à l'intérieur des établissements

 forçant leur évacuation et fermeture.


Au

lycée Alfred de Musset

 (Vaulx), les lycéen·nes ont mis le feu lundi. À

Brossolette

 (Villeurbanne), les tirs de mortiers et fumigène ont fait passer les cours en distanciel jeudi (les portiques et badgeuses ont été cramées la semaine dernière). Au

lycée René Descartes

 (Saint-Genis-Laval), jusque là peu mobilisé, des tirs de mortiers ont aussi foutu le zbeul, tout comme au

lycée Jacques Brel

 (Vénissieux).


Répression devant les établissements


L'ouverture des grilles des bahuts, en particulier des banlieues de Lyon se fait

sous la surveillance des

CRS

, de la

PN

 ou de la

BAC

.


Une grosse présence policière

 en particuliers

à Vaulx-en-Velin

, devant le lycée Robert Doisneau,

et à Villeurbanne

, au lycée Alfred de Musset, Pierre Brossolette et Auguste & Louis Lumière.


Cette semaine encore, les

lycées ont été débloqués par les keufs

, avec un usage massif de gaz lacrymogène.

Plusieurs élèves ont été envoyés en

GAV

, parfois

arrêtés à l'intérieur même des établissements

, comme la semaine dernière au lycée Lumière, cette fois-ci au

 lycée René Descartes

 à Saint-Genis-Laval.


Des agents de sécurités

 sont désormais déployés par le rectorat/la métropole, c'est le cas notamment au lycée Brossolette.


Lundi, le Maire de Vaulx-en-Velin et son adjointe se sont déplacés devant le collège Barbusse aux côtés de la police.


Répression à l'intérieur des établissements


Les chefs d'établissements durcissent la répression

 à l'intérieur des lycées.


Pour casser la mobilisation : passage en distanciel / fermeture administrative.

 Des dizaines de lycées concernés cette semaine encore : lycée Marcel Sembat, lycée Lumière, lycée Jean Perrin, lycée Lacassagne, lycée Fays, lycée Édouard Herriot, lycée Martinière Monplaisir, lycée Diderot, lycée Curie, lycée Colbert, lycée Condorcet, lycée René-Descartes, lycée Ampère…


Dans certains établissements, l'organisation des emplois du temps et la répartition des élèves en sous-groupes de travail permet à l'administration de diviser les lycéen·nes pour les empêcher de se mobiliser.


Une multiplication des conseils de discipline et des exclusions.

 25 conseils de discipline la semaine dernière aux

lycée Édouard Branly

 (5

e

), cette semaine, 5 conseils de discipline au

lycée Jean-Paul Sartre

 (Bron), 3 au

lycée Ampère

 (2

e

), plusieurs à

Jean Perrin

 (9

e

), au moins 10 conseils en préparation au

lycée Jacques Brel

 (Vénissieux)…


Au

lycée Récamier

 (2

e

),

5 élèves identifié·es comme

leader

 du blocus ont été exclu·es une semaine et une plainte a été déposée contre elleux

 pour avoir bloqué en étant masqué·es. Iels ont été démasqué·es un matin de blocus la semaine dernière par la

BAC

 qui les a remis remis au proviseur.


Cette répression des lycéen·nes par les établissements est confortée par

le gouvernement qui a adressé vendredi un télégramme aux recteurs et aux préfets

, en détaillant le dispositif pour

sanctionner les élèves et les membres du personnel de l'éducation nationale

 qui participeraient à des blocages, à des dégradations et «

 

à la déstabilisation de [leur] établissement

 

».

title: Welatiyên sûryanî li Sûriyeyê daxwaza naskirina zimanê xwe kirin
content:
Bi dehan şêniyên Suryan ji bo daxwaza naskirineke fermî ji bo zimanê suryanî di perwerdeya giştî de, li pêşiya Gerînendetiya Perwerdeyê ya li bajarê Hesekê çalakiyek li dar xist.


Beşdarên çalakiyê pankartên ku li ser bi zimanê suryanî, kurdî, erebî û ingilîzî daxwazên xwe yên naskirina zimanê suryanî, siberoja perwerdeya fermî û parastina saziyan dikin, rakirin.


Berpirsyara Saziya Olef Taw a Zimanê Suryanî Sofiya Yûsif di çalakiyê de daxuyaniyek xwend û wiha anî ziman:


“Mafê me yê dîrokî û çandî heye û nabe ku bê paşguhkirin, zimanê suryanî ne tenê wesîleya dan û standinê ye, ew nasname, bîr û mîrateya şaristanî û mirovahiyê ye, parastina wê berpirsyariyeke nîştimanî ye.”


Di daxuyaniyê de ev daxwaz hatin kirin:


- Divê zimanê suryanî bê naskirin û mafê wê yê destûrî û qanûnî bê misogerkirin.


- Divê derbasî dibistan û materyalên perwerdeyê yên fermî bibe.


- Divê saziyên perwerdeyê yên suryanî bên naskirin.


- Divê mafê nifşên nû yê perwerdeya bi zimanê dayikê bê misogerkirin û bê parastin.


Di daxuyaniyê de hat destnîşankirin ku daxwazên wan ne li dijî tu kesî ne û ji hebûna ziman an pêkhateyekê kêm nake, divê li Sûriyeyê mafê hemû pêkhateyan bê misogerkirin.


Çalakî bi berzkirina sloganan bi dawî bû.


(AY)


*Çavkanî û Fotograf: Hawarnews

author: Unknown
title: Эллис Алекси Милкмашрум - Голосуй как анархист
content:
Автор

: Эллис Алекси Милкмашрум

Название

: Голосуй как анархист

Дата

: 10.09.2026

Источник

: https://t.me/uralfreedom/26


 Сразу оговоримся, что изложенный в данной статье подход вполне вероятно не является универсальным. По нашему мнению, на момент его создания, план применим к странам СНГ, Южной Кореи, Японии, Великобритании, США и части Евросоюза, однако это деление носит спекулятивный характер.


Часть 1. Что мы можем изменить?


 В перечисленных выше странах относительно устойчиво сложилась либо двухпартийная, либо околооднопартийная, с вкраплением малозначительных партий в парламент, система. Притом формальных препон для изменения их в данных государствах не установлено.


 Итак, представим, что гражданин одной из этих стран, который недоволен статусом кво и хочет его изменить. Какие здесь возможны стратегии?


 Вначале разберёмся с условно двухпартийными системами. Для удобства скажем, что есть крупнейшие партии: А и В, которые стабильно делят между собой парламент, меняя лишь пропорции кресел. Также есть три относительно активные и зарегистрированные партии C, D, F, которые никогда не побеждали на выборах главы государства и практически не имеют шансов занять хотя бы одно место в парламенте.


 Также партии A и B имеют по две фракции внутри себя: у партии A это более консервативное и более либеральное крылья, а у партии B более экономически правое и более левое.


 Притом программы партий А и В для вас не носят значимых фактических различий, и обе являются непривлекательными.


 Наиболее приемлемыми на этих выборах для вас являются либеральное крыло партии А, правое крыло партии В и партия С.


 Таким образом, вы можете проголосовать за партию А, тем самым в основной массе поддержав чуждых вашим взглядам людей, немного усилив либеральное крыло, но тем и ослабив правое крыло и партию С, аналогичная ситуация лишь с отзеркаленными переменными произойдёт, если вы проголосуете за правое крыло партии В.


 Вариант же с голосованием за партию С одновременно остаётся и самым хорошим и самым плохим, поскольку с одной стороны вы, вероятно, испытаете наибольшее моральное спокойствие, так как не поддержали никого, кто бы противоречил вашим взглядам напрямую, но с другой стороны, партия С почти гарантированно разобьётся о проходной барьер, и вы своим голосом не поможете никому.


 Также первые два варианта приносят весьма шаткий и уязвимый результат, в силу партийных ротаций, зачастую маргинализированного статуса подобных крыльев, определяющей роли мейнстримного партруководства, возможных обвинений в отходе от линии партии от большинства или неудачных праймериз.


 Из этого вытекает, что с такой диспозицией вероятность ощутимо и хотя бы относительно долгосрочно что-то улучшить ничтожно мала, какую бы стратегию участия вы не избрали.


 Теперь рассмотрим второй вариант, обычно в нём в партиях не так развита фракционность, а если она и представлена, то зачастую весьма условно, поскольку несогласные с линией партии в данном случае скорее тяготеют к выделению себя в новую партию или переход в другую, уже существующую, с более близкой им программой, поэтому для простоты здесь фракционность рассматривать не будем.


 Есть правящая партия X, которая стабильно получает конституционное большинство. Есть ещё шесть зарегистрированных относительно активных партий, которые в разных пропорциях и наборах заполняют остаток парламентских кресел. Часть из них занимают сравнительно противоположные другим партиям позиции, что сводит к минимуму возможность образования коалиции в формате «все против партии X». Скажем из этих шести вы симпатизируете партиям Y, W и Q. При этом партии W и Q не всегда проходят барьер, а поскольку их электорат пересекается, ощутимый успех одной может привести к непроходу и аннигиляции голосов отданных за другую. Но также и чрезмерный успех партии Y может привести к тому, что одна, или обе другие партии не окажутся в созыве.


 Как, наверное, вы уже догадались: хорошего варианта здесь нет, но есть два возможных подхода, первый -- более консервативный: голосовать за партию Y, она почти точно пройдёт и ваш голос не пропадёт, но, конечно, повышается шанс, что сгорят голоса людей, голосовавших за оставшиеся две партии; вторая стратегия более рисковая: голосовать за партию, которая по предварительной оценки борется за порог, поскольку с одной стороны, ваш голос здесь значит ощутимо больше, чем в предыдущем варианте, поскольку так вы можете «спасти» голоса других людей, но с другой, ваш голос также может сгореть …

title: Doğan: Individual armament is a problem for society as a whole
content:
Ikram Doğan, Istanbul Branch Chair of the Association of Social Workers (SHUDER), spoke to ANF about the impact of individual gun ownership and violence on public health. Doğan stressed that violence cannot be explained solely by individuals' anger management problems or aggressive tendencies, drawing attention to economic insecurity, inequality, the perception of impunity and easy access to firearms.


According to media reports, 110,470 unlicensed firearms were seized across Turkey in 2025. Between 1 January and 26 March 2026, another 25,580 unlicensed firearms were confiscated.


Doğan said that individual gun ownership cannot be addressed solely as a matter of security and public order, emphasising the need to strengthen public social services and develop social policies aimed at preventing violence.


'The structural causes of violence are being obscured'


Doğan said that explaining incidents of violence solely through individual characteristics conceals the social dimensions of the problem.


Doğan said: "In an environment where gun ownership is becoming increasingly widespread, inequalities are deepening and social problems are increasingly being resolved through power relations, explaining violence solely in terms of individuals' anger management, aggressive tendencies or personal pathologies makes the structural causes of the problem invisible.


Violence is a consequence. The social inequalities that produce it, economic insecurity, gender relations, exclusion, discrimination, polarisation, the perception of impunity and the resulting distrust of justice, easy access to firearms, the normalisation of violence in everyday life and problems with public security policies must all be considered together. It is impossible to explain violence without questioning the social, economic and political conditions that produce it."


'Access to firearms increases the risk of fatal consequences'


Doğan said that easier access to firearms contributes to the spread of individual gun ownership and encourages the use of force and the perception of violence as a means of resolving social problems.


Doğan continued: "Easier access to firearms, in particular, increases the likelihood that even ordinary disagreements arising in everyday life will have fatal consequences. While firearms are increasingly regarded by some individuals as instruments of power and security, they also increase the risk of conflict and violence in social relations. Therefore, individual gun ownership is not merely a problem of individual behaviour but also an issue that must be addressed in terms of public oversight and social security."


'The impact of violence extends beyond those killed or injured'


Doğan said that the most visible impact of individual gun ownership on public health is the threat it poses to the right to life, noting that armed attacks, murders, injuries and suicides place a serious burden on public health.


Doğan stressed that the problem is not limited to those who lose their lives or suffer physical injuries. Doğan said: "Those who witness armed violence, those who lose loved ones, those who live under the threat of violence and everyone who feels unsafe are also direct or indirect victims of this process."


Doğan outlined the effects of individual gun ownership: "The threat of armed violence and witnessing violence can cause fear, anxiety, trauma, depression and symptoms of post-traumatic stress. A constant sense of threat negatively affects individuals' daily lives and social relationships.


When violence and firearms become part of everyday life, they undermine children's sense of security, developmental processes and social relationships. They increase the risk of children learning to regard violence as a demonstration of power or a method of solving problems.


The presence of firearms in the home can increase the risk of domestic conflicts, particularly violence against women, resulting in fatal consequences. It can pose serious threats to the lives and safety of women and children.


When people do not feel safe in public spaces, this leads to greater social insecurity, withdrawal from social life and a weakening of mutual trust. Violence therefore damages not only individuals' health but also the quality of social relationships.

title: Families of ill prisoners call for action outside Ministry of Justice
content:
The protest, initiated under the leadership of the Federation of Associations for Legal Solidarity with the Families of Prisoners and Convicts (TUHAD-FED), following a call by DEM Party MPs and the Association of Lawyers for Freedom (ÖHD), continued into its third day.


The protest was supported by the families of ill prisoners Newroz Bozkurt, Ömer Güneri, Yakup Akman, Mehmet Ali Taşkın and Selim Çiftçi, members of the Istanbul Peace Mothers’ Assembly, and the Human Rights Association (IHD).


A banner bearing the names of seriously ill prisoners was unfurled, reading: “We are at the gates of justice; we will open the prison gates through resistance. Freedom for sick prisoners.” Protesters chanted slogans including “Release sick prisoners!” and “Revolutionary prisoners are our honour!”


Families said they didn't want their children to die 


Fince Akman, the mother of ill prisoner Yakup Akman, said that their children were not receiving treatment in prison despite suffering from serious illnesses.


“We no longer want our children's coffins to be brought out of prisons. My child and thousands of other ill prisoners are not receiving treatment in prison. We say, ‘Peace’. The PKK has laid down its arms, but the state has taken no steps. The first thing that needs to happen is the release of sick prisoners,” she said.


Hülya Güner Münüklü, the sister of Ömer Güneri, who is held at Elazığ No. 2 Prison, said that her brother had been kept in solitary confinement for four years and had received no treatment for four months despite having a broken leg.


Hülya Güner Münüklü said they had been informed that the hospital was not equipped to perform the necessary surgery. “Why are our sick prisoners not being released? Is this what peace looks like? Is there no justice for Kurds? We have done everything we can; now they must take steps too. Enough is enough,” she said.


Safiye Doğan Ergin, a member of the Istanbul Peace Mothers’ Assembly, also called for the release of Newroz Bozkurt, a prisoner suffering from leukaemia who had been transferred to Etlik City Hospital. “We have come to take Newroz home. We will not leave without Newroz. Newroz is on the brink of death. Why should prisoners have to pay with their lives for their beliefs?” she said.


No new law is needed to release ill prisoners


Özgül Saki, a DEM Party MP for Istanbul, said that there were at least 1,412 sick prisoners in Turkey's prisons, 58 of whom were seriously ill and needed to be released immediately.


Saki stated that ill prisoners' demands for medical treatment and release were already recognised under international conventions and Turkey's domestic legislation, emphasising that preventing prisoners from receiving medical treatment constitutes a crime.


Speaking about the ongoing Peace and Democratic Resolution Process, Saki said that those who had been imprisoned for 20–30 years because of their demands for a democratic resolution should be released. “There is certainly no need for a new law just to release sick prisoners. With a decision by the Ministry of Justice, they could all be reunited with their families tomorrow,” she said.


Saki noted that while no deaths had occurred on the ground following the cessation of armed clashes, sick prisoners continued to lose their lives in prisons. “Turning a blind eye to preventable deaths is a war crime,” she said, reiterating her call for the immediate release of sick prisoners.


The sit-in protest outside the Ministry will resume today, Friday, at 2 p.m.

title: KESK’ten 12 Aralık Tandoğan Mitingine çağrı: "86 milyonun oluşturduğu bütçeden emekçiler pay alamıyor"
content:
Çorum- Kamu Emekçileri Sendikaları Konfederasyonu (KESK), 2027 yılı bütçesinde emekçilere yeterli pay ayrılmadığı gerekçesiyle Çorum’da basın açıklaması düzenledi. KESK Eş Genel Başkanı Ahmet Karagöz’ün katıldığı açıklamada, bütçenin emekçilerden yana hazırlanması çağrısı yapılırken, 12 Aralık’ta Ankara’da düzenlenecek mitinge katılım çağrısında bulunuldu.

KESK Eş Genel Başkanı Ahmet Karagöz, Eğitim Sen Örgütlenme Sekreteri İzzet İldeş ve KESK’e bağlı sendikaların yöneticilerinin katılımıyla Kadeş Barış Meydanı’nda basın açıklaması düzenlendi. “Sermayeye değil, emekçiye bütçe”, “Gün gelecek devran dönecek, AKP halka hesap verecek” ve “Kurtuluş yok tek başına, ya hep beraber ya hiçbirimiz” sloganlarının atıldığı açıklamaya KESK’e bağlı sendikaların şube başkanları ve üyelerinin yanı sıra Yeni Parti İl Başkan Yardımcısı Garip Özgür, Emek Partisi İl Başkanı Muharrem Özünel, DEM Parti İl Başkanı Hasan Satılmış ve Çorum Emek ve Demokrasi Platformu Sözcüsü Av. Ahmet Özdel de destek verdi.

Basın açıklamasında konuşan Karagöz, AKP’nin 25 yıl önce yasaklar, yoksulluk ve yolsuzlukla mücadele vaadiyle iktidara geldiğini ancak bugün ülkenin ağır sorunlarla karşı karşıya olduğunu söyledi. Karagöz, 86 milyon yurttaşın oluşturduğu kaynakların toplumun geniş kesimlerinin ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda kullanılmadığını savunarak, bütçeden emekçilerin, işçilerin, emeklilerin, çiftçilerin, öğrencilerin ve kadınların yeterli pay alamadığını ifade etti.

Bütçelerin, gelirlerin kimlerden toplandığını ve hangi kesimler için harcandığını gösteren belgeler olduğunu belirten Karagöz, mevcut bütçede sermaye gruplarının, cemaatlerin, tarikatların ve çok uluslu şirketlerin öncelikli olduğunu kaydetti. Toplumun ortak kaynaklarını oluşturmasına rağmen geniş kesimlerin bütçeden yeterince yararlanamadığını dile getiren Karagöz, 12 Aralık’ta Ankara Tandoğan Meydanı’nda KESK, DİSK, TMMOB ve TTB tarafından “Gelirden, vergiden adalet; halk için bütçe, demokratik Türkiye” sloganıyla miting düzenleneceğini açıkladı.

2027 yılı bütçe görüşmelerine de değinen Karagöz, bütçede emekçilere yeterli pay ayrılmadığını, buna karşın faiz, rant, savunma sanayisi, silah şirketleri, cemaatler ve tarikatlara kaynak aktarıldığını belirtti. Çocukların okulda tükettiği simit ve ayrandan alınan vergilerin dahi bütçeye katkı sunduğunu belirten Karagöz, okula giden her dört öğrenciden birinin aç olduğunu öne sürdü. Üniversite öğrencilerinin barınma sorunları nedeniyle eğitimlerini bırakıp ailelerinin yanına dönmek zorunda kaldığını kaydetti.

Çiftçilerin ürettikleri ürünleri değerinde satamadığını, borçlarını ödeyebilmek için ürünlerini veya topraklarını elden çıkarmak zorunda kaldığını ifade eden Karagöz, esnafın da ekonomik sıkıntılar nedeniyle kepenk kapattığını, iş yerlerinin iflas ettiğini ve çalışanların işten çıkarıldığını söyledi. Ülkenin insan onuruna yakışır bir yaşam için yeterli kaynaklara sahip olduğunu savunan Karagöz, kaynakların adil dağıtılmadığını dile getirdi.

Emekçilerin yoksulluk, emeklilerin açlık, gençlerin geleceksizlik ve belirsizlik, kadınların ise yoksulluk ve eşitsizlikle mücadele ettiğini belirten Karagöz, bu kesimlerin ihtiyaçlarına yönelik kaynak aktarılmadığını söyledi. Meraların, ormanların ve doğal alanların talan edildiğini, işçilerin iş yerlerinde yaşamını yitirdiğini ifade eden Karagöz, AKP’nin 25 yıllık iktidarı döneminde Türkiye genelinde 39 bin işçinin hayatını kaybettiğini belirterek, işçi sağlığı ve iş güvenliğine daha fazla kaynak ayrılması gerektiğini vurguladı.

2027 yılı bütçe taslağında kaynakların yüzde 20’sinin faize, yüzde 18’inin silah sektörüne ayrıldığını ifade eden Karagöz, ülkede yürütülen barış sürecini değerli bulduklarını ancak savunma ve silah sektörüne yüksek miktarda kaynak aktarılmasını düşündürücü olarak değerlendirdiklerini söyledi. Kaynakların işçilerin, emekçilerin ve emeklilerin talepleri doğrultusunda kullanılmasını istedi.

Kamusal hizmetlerin azaldığını, kurumların ve fabrikaların özelleştirildiğini belirten Karagöz, kamu yatırımlarına daha fazla pay ayrılması, özelleştirmeler yerine kamulaştırmaya kaynak aktarılması çağrısında bulundu. Meraların, doğal alanların ve zeytinliklerin sermayeye açılmasına tepki gösterdi.

Ülkede yoksulluğun yanı sıra yasaklar ve adaletsizliklerle de mücadele edildiğini savunan Karagöz, gazetecilerin, seçilmiş belediye başkanlarının, milletvekillerinin, hak arayan işçilerin ve sendikacıların tutuklu olduğunu, öğrencilerin gözaltına alındığını söyledi.

title: Belediye meclislerinde başkan seçimine ilişkin yeni usul Resmi Gazete'de
content:
Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı'nın hazırladığı yönetmelik değişikliği 20 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı. Düzenleme, belediye meclislerinin kendi üyeleri arasından yaptığı başkan ve başkanvekili seçimlerinin kurallarını yeniden belirliyor.


9 belediye başkanı AKP'ye geçti


19 Kasım 2026


Yeni oylama usulü


Oylamada basılı birleşik oy pusulası kullanılacak. Üyeler, tercih ettikleri adayın adının yanına mühür basacak. Oy pusulasına elle isim yazılmayacak.


Meclis salonunda en az iki kapalı oy kabini bulunacak. Mühürlü zarflar şeffaf sandığa atılacak. Adaylar oturumu yönetemeyecek, ancak oy kullanabilecek. Her parti grubu ile bağımsızlar birer gözlemci bildirebilecek.


Ahmet Özer: "Ver belediyeyi gir içeri suçuna sonra bakarız dediler"


11 Kasım 2026


Adaylık ve geçersiz oylar


Adaylık başvuruları, valinin belirleyeceği seçim toplantısının ilk oturumunda meclis başkanlık divanına bildirilecek. Bu oturumdan sonra yeni başvuru alınmayacak. Adaylar her tur öncesi çekilebilecek.


Mühür taşımayan, tanıtıcı işaret içeren ya da birden fazla adaya mühür basılmış pusulalar geçersiz sayılacak. Sandıktan çıkan zarf sayısı oy kullanan üye sayısını aşarsa ilgili tur iptal edilip yeniden oylama yapılacak.


Saklama


Pusulalar ve zarflar, dava süresi dolana kadar saklanacak. Dava açılmışsa mahkeme kararı kesinleşene kadar saklanmaya devam edilecek.


Ne olmuştu?


Düzenleme, oylamada gizliliği ve şeffaflığı artırmayı, adaylık ve oy kullanma süreçlerini standartlaştırmayı ve itirazlarda izlenebilirliği sağlamayı amaçlıyor. Haberde 31 Mart 2024'ten bu yana, 4'ü büyükşehir olmak üzere 117 belediyede yönetimin transferlerle değiştiği belirtiliyor.

title: Bir yarış oyunundan kültürel fenomene: Grand Theft Auto'nun ortaya çıkış hikâyesi
content:
Video oyunları dünyasının en çok beklenen yapımlarından Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6), 13 yıllık bekleyişin, ertelemelerin ve sızıntıların ardından oyuncularla buluştu.

Bugün milyonlarca insanın merakla beklediği serinin temelleri, 1997 yılında İskoçya'nın Dundee kentinde, DMA Design adlı görece küçük bir oyun stüdyosunda atılmıştı.

Bulmaca oyunu Lemmings ile başarı kazanan stüdyo, başlangıçta Race'n'Chase adını taşıyan bir yarış oyunu geliştirmeyi planlıyordu. Ancak ekibin geleneksel yarış oyunlarından farklı bir deneyim yaratma arayışı, video oyunları tarihini değiştirecek bir fikrin ortaya çıkmasını sağladı.

Serinin yaratıcılarından Dave Jones, dönemin oyunlarından farklılaşmak için geliştirdikleri en önemli özelliğin, oyuncuların kullandıkları otomobillerden inebilmesi olduğunu anlatıyor.

Oyuncuların araç değiştirebilmesi, otomobil çalabilmesi ve şehirde yaya olarak dolaşabilmesi, farklı oyun türlerinin bir araya gelmesine olanak tanıdı.

Geliştirme ekibi başlangıçta oyuncuların hem suçlu hem de polis memuru olarak oynayabileceği bir oyun tasarlamıştı. Ancak polis karakterini yönetmenin oyunculara getireceği kurallar ve sınırlamalar nedeniyle bu fikirden vazgeçildi.

Jones, o dönemde aldıkları kararı, "Bir noktada, 'Biliyor musunuz, kötü adamı oynamak çok daha eğlenceli' dedik, bu yüzden oyunun konusu da bu oldu" sözleriyle anlatıyor.

İlk GTA'nın satışları, stüdyonun önceki başarısı Lemmings'e kıyasla yavaş ilerledi. Jones'a göre bunun nedenlerinden biri, oyunun sunduğu yeniliklerin ancak oynandığında anlaşılabilmesiydi.

İlk oyunun senaryosunu yazan ve tanıtımından sorumlu olan Brian Baglow ise oyunun yıl boyunca satışlarını sürdürdüğünü, oyuncuların birbirlerine tavsiye etmesiyle giderek daha geniş bir kitleye ulaştığını belirtiyor.

Suç ve şiddet temaları nedeniyle İngiltere Parlamentosunda da tartışma konusu olan GTA'nın yasaklanması yönünde çağrılar yapıldı. Oyunun yayıncısı BMG Interactive'in bu tartışmaları bir pazarlama stratejisi olarak kullandığı daha sonra ortaya çıktı.

Kuşbakışı kamera açısı ve iki boyutlu grafikleriyle bugünkü GTA oyunlarından oldukça farklı görünen ilk yapım, serinin kendine özgü mizah anlayışının da temellerini attı.

The Guardian'ın video oyunları editörü Keza MacDonald'a göre GTA'nın Amerikan şehirlerini abartılı biçimde tasvir etmesinde, geliştiricilerinin İskoçya'dan gelen gözlem gücünün önemli bir payı vardı.

MacDonald, "Bu son derece hiciv dolu bir oyun. ABD'nin aşırı bireyci ve aşırı kapitalist yapısını doğrudan hedef alıyor" diyor.

İlk oyunun sınırlı bütçesi ve gerçek markaların lisanslarını kullanmanın maliyeti, geliştiricileri kurgusal markalar yaratmaya yöneltti. Hayali radyo istasyonları, reklamlar ve işletme isimleri zamanla serinin karakteristik özellikleri arasına girdi.

Başlangıçta ekonomik zorunluluklardan doğan bu tercihler, oyuncuların içinde bulunduğu şehrin kendine ait bir kültürü ve gündelik hayatı olduğu hissini güçlendirdi.

Baglow, yaklaşık 30 yıl sonra ilk oyuna ilişkin en fazla gurur duyduğu özelliğin bu kurgusal dünyanın inşası olduğunu söylüyor.

2013 yılında piyasaya sürülen GTA 5, üç gün içinde 1 milyar dolar gelir elde ederek eğlence sektöründe o güne kadarki en hızlı gelir elde eden ürün oldu.

Serinin etkisi yıllar içinde video oyunlarının sınırlarını da aştı. GTA'nın adı sinema filmlerinde ve gündelik konuşmalarda kullanılan bir kültürel referansa dönüştü.

MacDonald, serinin ilk dönemlerinde sinemadan yoğun biçimde beslendiğini, bugün ise sinemanın GTA'dan ne ölçüde etkilendiğinin tartışıldığını belirtiyor.

Jones'a göre serinin bu kadar geniş bir kitleye ulaşmasının nedenlerinden biri, oyuncuların aşina oldukları bir dünyada geçmesi. Fantastik veya bilim kurgu evrenlerinin aksine GTA, oyunculardan yeni bir dünyanın kurallarını öğrenmelerini beklemiyor.

Serinin yeni oyununun hem kapsam hem de gelir bakımından GTA 5'i geride bırakması bekleniyor.

PlayStation ve Xbox, GTA 6'nın kendi dijital mağazalarının tarihinde en fazla ön sipariş verilen oyun olduğunu açıkladı. Oyunun 212 gigabaytlık boyutunun da oyuncuların ön sipariş vererek indirme işlemini önceden tamamlamak istemelerinde etkili olduğu değerlendiriliyor.

Oyuna yönelik ilgi, reklam kampanyalarıyla şehirlerin gündelik hayatına da taşındı. Londra'daki Selfridges mağazasında oyunun kurgusal şehri Vice City temalı bir alan oluşturulurken Miami'de GTA evrenindeki hayali markaların reklamları yayımlandı.

title: Gram altın 6 bin liranın altına geriledi
content:
Küresel piyasalardaki gelişmeler ve ABD merkezli makroekonomik beklentiler, altın fiyatlarında sert düşüşe yol açtı. Ons altın son günlerde yaşadığı kayıplarla 14 ayın en düşük seviyesine inerken, gram altın da kritik eşik olan 6 bin liranın altına geriledi.

20 Kasım işlemlerinde 3.550 dolara kadar inen ons altın, bugün TSİ 07.26 itibarıyla 3 bin 532 dolar seviyesinde işlem gördü. Gram altın ise 5 bin 716 liraya kadar geriledikten sonra sabah seansında TSİ 07.26 itibarıyla 5 bin 735 lira bandında hareket etti.

Altın fiyatları üzerindeki baskıda doların güçlenmesi belirleyici unsurlar arasında yer aldı. Dolar endeksinin 104 seviyesine dayanması, dolar cinsinden fiyatlanan altını diğer para birimlerini kullanan yatırımcılar açısından daha pahalı hale getirerek uluslararası talebi zayıflattı.

Düşüşte, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) aralık ayında faiz artıracağı yönündeki beklentiler ve Fed cephesinden gelen "daha sıkı adımların gerekebileceğine" dair mesajlar etkili oldu. Öte yandan ABD tahvil piyasasında yükselen getiriler de altının cazibesini azalttı; ABD'nin 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi yüzde 5'in üzerinde seyrederken, 10 yıllık enflasyondan arındırılmış reel getiri yüzde 2,85-2,90 bandına dayandı. Getirisi bulunmayan altın karşısında tahvillerin öne çıkması, değerli metal üzerindeki satış baskısını artırdı.

author: Igor de Paula
title: Oxê de Xangô: o que representa o machado iorubá de duas lâminas que chegou ao STF
content:
Um machado com lâminas dos dois lados que simboliza a consideração de todos os lados de uma controvérsia. Esse é o Oxê de Xangô, um dos principais símbolos da Justiça e da busca pela verdade na tradição dos povos Iorubá da África Ocidental. 


O mesmo pode se dizer de Xangô, o Orixá do trovão e do fogo, que são elementos que representam justiça, razão, imparcialidade e equilíbrio. O Oxê é seu principal símbolo e ferramenta. 


Não por acaso essa foi a escultura escolhida para ser exposta no hall do Salão Nobre do edifício-sede do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), em Brasília. A cerimônia de descerramento da obra foi realizada na última terça-feira, 17 de novembro, em homenagem ao Dia da Consciência Negra, comemorado nesta sexta-feira, 20.


A chegada da escultura ao STF atende a uma solicitação do Instituto de Defesa dos Direitos das Religiões Afro-Brasileiras (Idafro). O pedido foi feito após o Plenário do Supremo, em novembro de 2024, decidir que a presença de símbolos religiosos em locais e órgãos públicos não é capaz de ferir a laicidade do Estado. 


Para o advogado Hédio Silva Júnior, fundador e coordenador executivo do Idafro, a inclusão do Oxê de Xangô entre os símbolos de Justiça do Supremo reafirma os preceitos constitucionais da promoção da igualdade racial e religiosa, do sancionamento cível e criminal da violência racial e religiosa, além da valorização da diversidade. 


“Lamentavelmente há um número significativo de aplicadores do Direito que tratam a censura constitucional ao racismo como ‘tutela de suscetibilidade, de melindres’, o tristemente famoso ‘mimimi’. Mas o racismo traumatiza, flagela, adoece e mata milhões de brasileiros e deve ser tratado exatamente como prevê a Constituição Federal”, ressalta Hédio Silva em entrevista à

Agência Pública

.


Hédio Silva Júnior afirma que Supremo reafirma o princípio constitucional da igualdade racial e religiosa ao receber o Oxê de Xangô


Símbolos de Justiça


Hédio Silva destaca que desde que deliberou a constitucionalidade das cotas raciais em 2012, o Supremo já havia rompido com a mística da justiça cega, comumente representada pelas deusas Iustitia, de origem romana, Diké e Astreia (gregas), cujas principais características são os olhos vendados e a presença de uma balança com os pratos equilibrados nas mãos. 


“O Oxê de Xangô atualiza e ressignifica não apenas a representação da Justiça, mas reafirma a imperiosa necessidade de que a administração da Justiça, a jurisdição, seja exercida com imparcialidade, equidistância e com base em fatos e provas. Não inspirada em pré-compreensões ou preferências raciais dos julgadores”, observa o advogado. 


Estado Laico e plural 


A chegada do Oxê de Xangô ao Salão Nobre do STF foi resultado de um percurso longo. Foram anos de um imbróglio jurídico em torno de símbolos religiosos, como crucifixos, expostos em instituições públicas, e o caráter laico do Estado.


Em 2009, o Ministério Público Federal (MPF) ajuizou uma ação civil pública solicitando a retirada de símbolos religiosos em prédios destinados ao atendimento público em São Paulo. O pedido foi rejeitado pela Justiça Federal que entendia à época que a laicidade do Estado não impedia a exposição de símbolos religiosos nos órgãos públicos porque eles refletiam a história regional e nacional. 


O pedido também foi negado em segunda instância no Tribunal Regional Federal da 3ª Região, sob o mesmo argumento da Justiça Federal. O MPF recorreu das primeiras decisões e o debate chegou ao Supremo Tribunal em 2020.


Em novembro de 2024, por unanimidade, o Plenário da Corte acabou com a polêmica ao decidir pela manutenção dos símbolos religiosos em prédios públicos, considerando que a presença deles não contraria a laicidade do Estado, desde que o objetivo seja manifestar a tradição cultural da sociedade. 


O ministro Cristiano Zanin, relator do caso, liberou a presença de símbolos religiosos em prédios públicos pertencentes a qualquer um dos três poderes, da União, dos estados, do Distrito Federal e dos municípios.


Com o fim da controvérsia e a pacificação do entendimento pelo STF, o Idafro enxergou uma oportunidade e entrou com uma solicitação, em fevereiro de 2025, de instalação da escultura do Oxê de Xangô no edifício-sede da Corte. Em seus argumentos, o Instituto defendeu que a medida seria uma forma de ampliar a representatividade religiosa no local, já que no próprio salão onde o plenário do STF se reúne, atrás da cadeira do presidente, encontra-se um …

author: Bulatlat Contributors
title: Baclaran vendors bear the cost of ASEAN Summit
content:
By Reachelyn Esona and Roselle Ochobillo

From bustling streets to empty sidewalks.

This may be an image of order for some, but for Baclaran street vendors, it can mean another day of uncertainty over whether they will have earnings to take home.

In the first week of November, the local government of Parañaque City ordered a clearing operation in barangay Baclaran in time for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nation (ASEAN) summit from November 15 to 17.

The Parañaque local government said that the barangay would temporarily prohibit street vendors along Roxas Boulevard, service roads, Redemptorist Road, Quirino Avenue, and beneath LRT-1 from November 2 to November 20, to clear the way for the arriving delegates.

Among those forced to leave their usual vending spots is Eduardo Bargas, 59, who’s been selling toys along Baclaran for almost 20 years to support his wife and only child. After being dislocated, he resorted to selling bottled water to earn a living despite the imposed clearing operation.

According to Bargas, they were informed about the operation as early as November 1. While larger vendors operating inside stall establishments were allowed to continue selling, ambulant vendors like him were temporarily ordered to stop their operations.

Bargas was nearly apprehended once by the authorities. Had he been caught, he said, his goods would have been confiscated. He begged the authorities not to take his items as it was all he had to live on.

Like other vendors, Bargas’s income was severely impacted by the clearing operation. He said he used to earn up to P1,000 (approximately US$ 15.63) a day before the policy was implemented. Now, he takes home only around P300 (approximately US$ 4.69).

The same concern was shared by a 50-year-old towel and sack bag vendor, Marlyn Merioles. She sells along Baclaran to sustain her elderly mother who is on maintenance medication, and her sibling who is a person with disability.

Before the clearing, Merioles was earning around P300 (approximately US$ 4.69) to P500 (approximately US$ 7.82) a day. Since the operation began, there were days she went home with empty pockets.

Merioles said she felt disheartened by the policy. Vendors, she said, are now anxious and find it difficult to sell their goods. They are constantly on their feet, keeping an eye out for patrols roaming the area. Merioles fears that she might not see them coming as her eyesight is already failing.

They were also warned that their goods would be confiscated if they were caught. Merioles said it would be a loss they could not afford because even a whole day of selling was not enough to recover the capital they had borrowed.

Merioles said it would help if the government would sustain their daily expenses. However, she said, only a few of the vendors benefitted from the financial assistance provided for the vendors.

While the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) promised P10,000 (approximately $156.35) in cash assistance to vendors affected by the clearing operations in Baclaran, some vendors said they struggled to access the financial aid because it was reportedly limited to registered voters of Baclaran.

Rochelle Maale, who has been renting a stall in Baclaran for 10 years to sell ready-to-wear clothes, was among those who did not receive the assistance because she is not a registered voter in the area.

“The distribution of funds should be balanced… What about those who have been here for a long time but didn’t get anything?”Maale retorted.

Vendors argued that the assistance should be extended to everyone affected by the clearing operations, regardless of their place of residence, since they all experienced the impact of the clearing operations.

However, for many vendors, the issue goes beyond the limited eligibility for financial assistance.

They also questioned whether the P10,000 (approximately US$ 156.35) would be enough to sustain them after nearly 20 days of restricted operations.

Maale shared that the amount was insufficient to cover their daily expenses, especially amid rising costs of goods. “Will that P10,000 even last for a few days? No, it’s still not enough. That’s why vendors are struggling to make ends meet.”

She said some vendors have resorted to taking out loans to meet their everyday needs and restore their capital.

For vendors like Maale, the struggle extends beyond the clearing operations and financial assistance. What they need is a permanent and secure …

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: Groups decry abduction attempt on Lumad youth activist in Davao City
content:
Lumad youth activist Mawing Pangadas answers questions from members of the media during a candle-lighting activity at Freedom Park in Davao City on the 2nd death anniversary of New Bataan 5 on February 24, 2024. Photo from Panalipdan Youth Davao’s Facebook page

Progressive groups condemned the alleged abduction attempt on Lumad youth activist Mawing Pangadas in Davao City.

The Hands Off Mindanao Youth Activists (HOMYA) Network reported that around 10 to 12 individuals wearing all-black clothing and caps allegedly pursued the 24-year-old youth activist along Upper Madapo Hills, Barangay 8-A, on November 17 while he was on his way home.

“[They] tried to corner him and said, ‘This is him. Do not run’,” the network stated in its alert released on November 19.

Pangadas who belongs to the Indigenous Manobo reportedly was able to escape. He lost his phone and slippers and sustained injuries after he tripped and fell down during the pursuit which reportedly lasted for three hours.

The HOMYA network said that this incident reflects the continuing attacks and harassment faced by activists. “These acts of intimidation inflict serious mental, emotional, and psychological distress not only on Mawing, the direct target of these fascist attacks, but also on his family and loved ones who are forced to live under constant fear and anxiety.”

Read: Groups slam PNP official’s apology after tagging Mindanao activists as ‘wanted persons’

Lara Felescoso, spokesperson for Resist! Campaign, a human rights advocacy initiative, also considered the abduction attempt as an attack against Lumad youth and Indigenous community members who fight for their ancestral lands and fundamental rights.

Pangadas, who hails in Talaingod, Davao del Norte, was a former student of the Salugpongan Ta Tanu Igkanogon Community Learning Center, a now-defunct alternative school teaching Indigenous children in the Davao region. He was a relative of the late Manobo leader Bai Bibyaon Ligkayan Bigkay.

Fifty-five Salugpongan schools across the region were shut down in 2019 for allegedly violating Department of Education (DepEd) regulations and for training children to become members of the New People’s Army (NPA), an accusation that has been debunked by the school administration and human rights organizations.

Read: Groups urge gov’t to prioritize reopening of Lumad schools in Mindanao

During a protest in Davao City for the State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in 2022, Pangadas and his older brother Ismael were arrested by the police and faced criminal charges for alleged human trafficking. They were acquitted from these cases.

Read: Court acquits Lumad brothers, 3 teachers from human trafficking charges

Pangadas serves as the education and research officer of the environmental advocacy group Panalipdan Youth Davao and convenor of HOMYA, a network that has been established due to continuing attacks and harassment against activists in Mindanao.

With such circumstances, the HOMYA network did not rule out the possibility that the alleged abduction attempt might be state-perpetrated, raising suspicion that it is linked to the government’s counterinsurgency operations.

Various progressive groups and youth-led organizations demanded an immediate and impartial investigation to identify the perpetrators and hold them accountable. (DAA)

author: Brian Hioe
title: Trilateral Meeting Between Xi, Trump, and Putin Results In Little Substance, But Taiwan Should Remain Cautious
content:
THE TRILATERAL SUMMIT between US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping that was held earlier this week resulted in little of substance. Nevertheless, the summit should raise risks for Taiwan, seeing as Taiwan could stand to have its freedoms traded off through Trump’s unpredictable dealmaking.

Indeed, if the summit was intended to harken back to Yalta in the dealmaking that ended World War II, it did not have such significance. The three leaders came to an agreement about peace and nuclear disarmament, as well as boosting fuel production.

Ukraine came up indirectly, and even as Russian strikes on Ukraine continued during the meeting and its talk of peace, no agreement was made between the US and Russia on it. As reflected in the eventual readout, during the meeting, Trump lashed out at the International Criminal Court in what might be read as a conciliatory gesture to Putin, seeing as he is wanted by the court.

It may be fortunate for Taiwan, then–as with Ukraine–that it did not come up in the meeting. It is thought that the possibility of Trump taking some stance on Taiwan that would have signed away its freedoms to China was lessened by allegations against Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang that he was involved in an affair with a Chinese spy. It is probable that foreign policy hawks in the US leveraged on the scandal and framed the affair between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang as one involving Chinese spying in order to constrain Trump’s actions in the meeting.

It proves dangerous, however, for both Taiwan and Ukraine that Trump, Xi, and Putin would have a meeting without any Ukrainian or Taiwanese leaders present. And the presence of Xi is concerning for Taiwan, in that he apparently is seen by Trump as a stakeholder in what might otherwise be a bilateral meeting between Trump and Putin. Perhaps this goes to show how the Russian and Chinese governments have become increasingly intertwined in terms of joint interests, however.

Indeed, Xi and Putin are probably well aware of the Democratic wave that swept the US in recent midterm elections. Trump is now a lame duck, but he may still be intent on exercising power. Xi and Putin, then, could perhaps take advantage of an eagerness by Trump for quick wins in order to win concessions on Taiwan and Ukraine, much as Trump struck an oil deal with Putin to try and win a quick win in lowering oil prices in the US ahead of the vote. Consequently, it proves important for Taiwan, Ukraine, and other political actors to keep a close eye on moves by the three leaders to hold meetings–and to try and sink the possibility of deals that Trump may be willing to sign with Xi and Putin ahead of the actual meetings taking place, or in order to constrain his actions.

Domestically, however, one expects some of the usual suspects to actually take the rhetoric of peace by Trump, Xi, and Putin at face value. Insofar as the KMT has tried to sink closer ties between the US and Taiwan by claiming that this would lead Taiwan to suffer a fate like Ukraine, with a view of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine as caused by Ukraine getting too close to NATO, it is possible that the KMT would embrace the view that Taiwan, too, should seek a bargain with China, and that Trump could perhaps be convinced to back such a bargain. And it is also not impossible that Taiwan factors into the calculus of such leaders. Intrusions by Russian fighter jets into Taiwan’s Air Defense Identification Zone, in an apparent first, earlier this week were likely timed ahead of the meeting as a means of projecting power. As it has been twice this week that Russian intrusions have occurred, it is to be seen if this is a new feature of regional security.

title: Rêxistina Parastina Zarokan: 589 milyon zarok li herêmên şer dijîn
content:
Rêxistina Parastina Zarokan (Save the Children) têkildarî zarokên li herêmên şer dijî raporek belav kiriye. Li gorî raporê zarok herî zêde di sala 2025an de li herêmên şer jiyaye ango rûbirûyê şer bûne.


Di heman demê de binpêkirinên wekî rêgirîkirina li gihîştina alîkariyên mirovî, revandin û tundkariya zayendî bi awayekî berbiçav zêde bûne.


Li Afganistanê 3,7 milyon zarok bi xetereya birçîbûnê re rûbirû ne


5 Tebax 2026


Di rapora herî nû ya rêzeraporên bi navê "Şerê li Dijî Zarokan Rawestînin" de hat eşkerekirin ku sala 2025an li cîhanê 589 milyon zarok li herêmên şer jiyane.


Ev hejmar ji sala 1990î û vir ve ku tomarkirina amaran dest pê kiriye amara herî bilind e û ji du qat zêdetirî hejmara giştî ya nîvê salên 90î yên sedsala borî ye.


Artêşa Îsraîlê di 20 rojên dawî de 490 zarok qetil kirin


7 Nîsan 2025


Birêvebirê Rêxistina Parastina Zarokan a Almanyayê Florian Westphal got:


"Ji bo bi milyonan zarokan tirs, tundî û koçberî bûne beşek ji jiyana wan a rojane." 


Westphal her wiha amaje pê kir ku divê ev amar ji bo civaka navneteweyî bibin"zengilekî hişyarkirinê."


Herêmên şer ên ku zarok lê dijîn


Li gorî raporê  sala 2025an li parzemîna Afrîkayê û li Rojhilata Navîn ji her 5 zarokan nêzîkî 2 zarok li herêmên şer jiyane.


Li cîhanê ji zarokên ku li herêmên şer dijîn jê ji sedî 44ê wan tenê li parzemîna Afrîkayê ye.


Rêjeya zarokên ku li wê parzemînê rûbirûyê şer dibin di 15 salên borî de ji 3 qatan zêdetir zêde bûye; sala 2010an ji sedî 12 bû lê sala 2025an derketiye ji sedî 39an.


UNICEF: Ji Helebê 228 zarok gihîştin Rojava


16 Çile 2026


Li Rojhilata Navîn jî sala 2025an ji sedî 40,2yê zarokan li herêmên şer jiyane. Hejmara zarokên ku li herêmê di bin bandora şer de mane bi rêjeya nêzîkî ji sedî 29an zêde bûye; sala 2024an 52 milyon zarok bûn, sala 2025an derketiye 67 milyon zarokî.


Binpêkirinên metirsîdar


Li gorî raporê di sala 2025an 8 hezar û 322 bûyerên piştrastkirî yên rêgiriya li alîkariyên mirovî hatine tomarkirin ku li gorî dehsaleke berê 16 qat zêde bûye (sala 2015an tenê 509 bûyer û sala 2005an tenê 8 bûyer hatibûn tomarkirin).


Piraniya van bûyeran li Filistînê bi 5 hezar û 946 bûyeran hatine tomarkirin ku ev hejmar zêdetirî ji sedî 70yê hemû bûyerên tomarkirî yên cîhanê pêk tîne. Bi vî awayî, rêgirîkirina li alîkariyên mirovî piştî kuştin û kêmendamkirina zarokan bûyeduyem binpêkirina herî berbelav.


2025: Zarokan di bianet kurdiyê de çawa cih girtiye?


31 Kanûn 2025


Komkirina binpêkirinan


Li gorî lêkolînê, Neteweyên Yekbûyî bi giştî 38 hezar û 967 binpêkirinên giran ên li dijî zarokan ên sala 2025an piştrast kirine ku piştî amara rekor a sala 2024an (41 hezar û 763 binpêkirin) duyem amara herî bilind a salane ye.


Zêdetirî nîvê van binpêkirinan tenê li 3 deveran qewimîne ku ew jî Filistîn, Komara Demokratîk a Kongoyê û Nîjerya ne.


Tenê li Filistînê 12 hezar û 449 binpêkirinên piştrastkirî hatine tomarkirin ku nêzîkîsêyeka hemû bûyerên li cîhanê ye.


UNICEF: Li Xezeyê rojane 28 zarok dimirin


5 Tebax 2025


Amarên herî berbiçav ên binpêkirinên sala 2025an ev in:


Li gorî raporê, di şer de 14 hezar û 224 zarok hatine kuştin an kêmendam bûne. Di revandina zarokan de hejmareke rekor hatiye tomarkirin ku gihîştiye 5 hezar û 128bûyeran.


Hezar û 787 bûyerên tundiya zayendî hatine tomarkirin (di dehsaleke borî de bi rêjeya ji sedî 71 zêde bûye û ji sedî 86ê bûyeran li herêmên şer ên Afrîkayê, bi taybetî li Kongoû Sûdanê qewimîne).


Êrişên li ser dibistan û nexweşxaneyan ji bo sala 5an li ser hev zêde bûne û gihîştine 2hezar û 930 bûyeran; bi 837 êrişan li ser axa Filistînê û 643 êrişan li Ukraynayê ji nîvîzêdetirî êrişên cîhanê pêk anîne.
